## Chapter 60: Name
## Notes:
(See the end of the chapter for  notes.)
## Chapter Text

## Chapter 60: Name




I woke and the first thing I saw were ghoulish eyes hovering over me in the dim room.
My grip tightened on the sword at my side and I raised it to strike the ghoul’s throat with my eyes wide and wild.
The strength of the blow was fueled entirely by panic.

My breaths were frantic in the moments after waking up. The tip of the blade was held in the ghoul’s hand;
stopping it from striking his throat.  His hand was bleeding; dripping blood from his fingers. My other hand
gripped the girl in my arms. After what I’d already done, I could think of nothing but to protect her.

“Ai-chan...it’s me...Renji-kun is waiting downstairs...”

“U—ta?” I relaxed my grip on the sword and Uta lifted it by the blade and set it aside. “I—I’m so sorry...a-are you
okay? I didn’t mean to—”

“I’m fine. I shouldn't have startled you while you were sleeping.” He opened his palms and showed me the healing
cuts.
His eyes moved down to the child in my arms. The little ghoul child muttered in her sleep, nuzzled against my
neck. Completely undisturbed by my less than restful and calm awakening.

“...she’s still asleep.”

“Yeah...she is...” I frowned as I recalled the evening before with startling detail.
“...her mother . Did Nico and Itori—?”

Uta shook his head and I bit my inner cheek.
“How long have we been asleep...?”

“Most of the night...Ai-chan. It’s likely that her mother isn’t coming back for her. I was about her age when—”

“ Don’t say that .... Please ...” I hushed him in a quiet voice and felt my lip tremble before forcing a smile. “You’ll
jinx it, Uta-kun...So just don’t say it. Okay?”

The ghoul didn’t continue what he was going to say but I knew that as the minutes ticked by it was becoming less
and less likely that we found her mother.

“I hate to ask...but can she have some food you have here? It...wouldn’t hurt to take care of her for a while until
her mother comes and gets her...right?”

“Aika...”

I saw Uta’s slightly downturned frown and the way he was looking at me. It was a curious, almost searching gaze. I
wondered what he was thinking. What he thought of what I was doing.


“...I’m not in denial, Uta. I promise I’m not...if Itori hasn't found or heard anything in a day or two we can talk to
Yoshimura. He’ll know what to do. Like with Hinami...I don’t know if it’s rude to ask you to help feed her in the
meantime but—”

“No, it’s fine Ai-chan...” His ghoulish eyes glanced down as the little girl shifted in her sleep, her small hands
gripping tight to my shirt caked in blood. I felt gross. I smelled gross . The coppery metallic scent had turned rotten
in the hours that I’d slept.

“...I’ll get her something out to eat. We can watch her for a few days if need be. Itori and Nico will keep looking.”

I shifted to sit up moving the child slowly. One of her hands tangled in my hair and held tight; tugging on the
strands.

“Hey kiddo...time to wake up.” I don’t even know her name...

The little girl blinked slowly awake.
“Ma’ma?” The girl turned her head looking around and saw the unfamiliar setting. Her lip trembled when she
didn’t find her mother. It must be so scary...being a child. Being a Ghoul at this age. Strong, but still needing care.
Needing their parents to protect and feed them. Knowing that any second they might not have that anymore...

“ Hey–Hey ...it’s okay. It hasn’t been too long. They’re still looking. I’m sorry to wake you up...but Uta-kun is
getting some food. Are you hungry?”

The girl’s lip still trembled but her eyes lit up at the mention of food. Then, just as quickly her expression turned
bashful . Yes.She is hungry, isn't she? But maybe too embarrassed to say anything to me?

“Uta-kun’s got some things you can eat...don’t worry. Maybe after you have something to fill your belly you can
let Uta check over your mask. Make sure it wasn’t damaged when you were running away, okay? And you know
what kiddo...I think there’s some sparkly stickers around here somewhere. I can get you some paper and markers
and you can draw. How’s that sound?”

The little ghoul raised her head up and I saw her little blue eyes staring at me from behind the mask she still wore.
“Really..?”

“Yeah. Also...I’m not ‘Ms. Human’. My name is Aika. It’s nice to meet you. Is there something I can call you?”

“...Tsubame.” The girl replied shyly.

“That’s a very pretty name. Alright little bird!~ Let’s get you breakfast! Okay!?” The girl’s face brightened and she
pulled away and crawled off my lap, cracking and breaking the dried blood between us.
She stood nearby until I was standing; a moment later she was holding tight to my pant leg.

I offered my hand and she took it readily.


Bjorn raised his head and watched me and the girl move to the kitchen. After a minute he stood up and came after
us. Tsubame squeaked and wrapped herself around my leg; hugging tight and closing her eyes as the large dog
came close.
“It’s okay lil’ bird. This is Bjorn. He’s my dog. He’s a good boy...you can pet him. I know another lil’ girl who
absolutely adores him.”

The little girl peeked at the dog and then shook her head; nuzzling closer to my leg. She’s scared .

“Bjorn. Go on. You're a good boy but go lay down.” The dog cocked his head and then slowly lopped off to his
bed where he laid down with a huff.

“Here Ai-chan...for her.” Uta stepped out of the kitchen with a tupperware in his hand. It had sliced meat cut up
in ribbons for the little girl. I took it thankfully and then held it down to the child.

She raised her head and sniffed. Eagerly she reached out with her hands and grasped the container. Once she had it
she ran from my side and back to the couch, jumping up onto it and cuddling in the blood caked blanket while she
lifted the meat to her mouth and happily ate.

“Thank you Uta-kun...” I said softly. I raised my hands and turned them over. There was blood stuck under my
nails and in every line of my fingers. “...eeech...I smell terrible.”

“I can watch her for a few minutes while you clean up, Aika.”

I glanced up and found Renji standing just inside Uta’s apartment, he was kicking off his shoes and studying the
little ghoul child that I’d brought back to our home. The little girl stopped eating and looked at him with wide
fearful eyes.

She had stopped eating and just stared ; like every new thing or person was a threat.

“Tsubame...it’s okay. This is Renji-kun. He’s a very dear friend. Don’t worry. I promise you’re safe here!”

The girl glanced at me and then smiled wide; going back to eating right away.

“Renji...you don’t mind watching her for a minute? I need to scrub all this blood off...”
The girl had blood on her too. I wasn’t sure how comfortable she would be taking a bath here without her mother.
But at the very least I could give her one of my shirts and shorts to wear if she wanted to change.

The girl sprung up from the couch as soon as she was done with the food and ran towards me with the container
held up above her head. “I’m done, Ms. Aika!”

I chuckled softly, taking the empty container from her and putting it in the sink to be cleaned later.

“Good—how do you feel?”


“Good! I’m not hungry anymore!”

“That’s good. Renji-kun’s going to watch you for a minute. I’ve gotta clean up okay?”

Tsubame shook her head and reached for me, grasping onto my waist. “No! I wanna stay with you!”

“...Little bird. I need to get cleaned up. I can’t walk around covered in blood. Okay? We’ll get into trouble like
that.”

“....I don’t know him... ” The girl whispered and her bottom lip trembled. “Ma’ma said not to trust strangers...”

“ OH ...I see. Your ma’ma’s smart.” I looked to Renji and then Uta for help. Guess there wasn’t a choice then.
“Okay. How about you play with Uta-kun instead? You can stick right by him. You remember him, don’t you?
HE is the one that made your mask. And he’s my boyfriend!”

“I remember Mr. Mask Maker!”

“Right—Uta it is.”

The ghoul in question was staring at me with wide eyes as I picked up the kid, turned to him and put her in his
arms with a smile. “I won’t be long—Just watch her for a minute. Kay Uta-kun!?”

His eyes went wide as he held onto the child. The girl happily clung to him as she had me. She was already pointing
out the facial piercings he had when I grabbed clean towels and clothing to change into.

“Mr. Uta—Did those hurt your face?”

“Not really...”

I smiled faintly and closed the door behind me.
Cute. The kid was cute. The awkward way Uta didn’t know what to do with her when I handed her off was cute
too. Renji’s expression was too funny .

I stood in the bathroom and stared at the ground for a long time.
I knew it was a bad idea the moment before I did it but I looked in the mirror. My eyes look back out at me from a
foreign face. Smeared with dried blood. Some of it had already flaked off but I still looked like a murderer. Most of
me was covered in the gore of the night. Close range to a decapitation would do that.

It wasn’t red anymore though; it had turned brown. Like the blood in Uta’s containers after it had been there a
few days.

This is okay.

I won’t regret it. Or dwell on it.

Subhuman. Vermin. The words bounced off my skull and made me see red. That man had spoken about them like
they needed to be exterminated . Like bugs to be crushed under boot and forgotten. They were my friends. My
chosen family...as well as my blood relatives. They were important to me.

I might have felt bad if it was someone like Amon since he’d grown on me a bit. I also would have regretted killing
the rookie that had fled from the fight. He had seemed reluctant to be there. Perhaps after today he would rethink
his choice of career. I’m sure the benefits weren’t worth it. If, that is, he got out alright after deserting his partner.

Turning the water on first I let it heat up as I peeled layers of crinkling fabric from my body and tossed them away.
I climbed into the bathtub and picked up the sprayer head. I started at my head, rinsing the blood from my hair
and worked downwards. The rivers of water first turn red and brown, then faint pink before going clear.

I stepped out of the bath, headless of the dripping water I was tracking across the floor. I picked up my old
toothbrush and started to scrub under my nails with it. When I saw no more blood I finally tossed it in the bin—
making a note to get a fresh toothbrush after I was showered, dried and clothed again.

I ran the water as hot as it could get and stood under it for a long time before starting to scrub head to toe with
soap; relishing the way it burned my skin.

...The Auction was only a week or two away; wasn’t it? Despite everything in the last few hours, I hadn’t forgotten
about it. Nor had I gotten less bothered by it.

It was one thing to kill to eat. Kill to survive.
Human trafficking would happen between Humans; selling our own kind for all sorts of things. Whatever the
buyer wanted I supposed.

But I hadn’t— expected might not be the right word.
I had hoped that he wouldn’t have been mixed in with that sort of thing.
The fact that he was part of the Clowns should have been my first clue that his world was darker than most of my
other ghoul friends. Bloodier. Cruel.

Now wasn’t the time to talk about it though. Not with a child to look after until Itori found her mother.

## ♥

I exited the bathroom wearing new clean clothing and with a towel draped over my head. Uta sat on the couch
with the little ghoul’s mask in his hand, turning it over and inspecting it for any damage while the child ran circles
around the coffee table.

“Ms. Aika! Ms. Aika!!!” The little ghoul ran to me and wrapped her arms around my middle, her face pressed
against my stomach. “You smell nice!!!”

“Uh—Thank you. It’s some pretty flower soap I bought at a shop in the 20th ward. Do you want to change into

something not covered in...dirt? You can have some of my clothing. That way you’ll be a bit cleaner when your
mom comes to get you?”

The girl looked down at her white dress; the red stain on it. Her smile faltered and she looked up at me and
nodded.
“Okay little bird...come on. We’ll get you something.” She took my hand as I led her to our bedroom. I lifted her
up and set her on the edge of the bed before going to pick through my clothing.

In the end I picked out some shorts that were a little too small on me and a crop top T-shirt that would fit her
perfectly.

“Alright. You take these and you run over to the bathroom. Then bring me your dress, I’ll see if I can get the stain
out myself. Alright?”

The ghoul jumped from the bed and ran out of the room with the new clothing.
I followed slowly and looked around. Uta was still looking over the girl's mask.

“Is it broken at all?”

“...mmm...this latch is sticking.” Uta replied softly, fiddling with it.

“Maybe just replace that part. I could do it if you’d like to keep watching her.”

The ghoul looked up at me with wide eyes again and I giggled. Leaning down over the arm of the couch I kissed
his cheek: “Don’t worry Uta-kun...I’ll watch her. You don’t have to....Thank you for putting up with me. I’m not
saying we keep her here forever. Her mother is fine. She’ll come for her...I’m sure it won't be long. ”

Uta wanted to say something but I could see he was holding back once more; his eyes searching my face once
more.

“...I know I’m being foolishly optimistic. I just really want it to be true... Okay?”

“...I know Ai-chan. Renji left to help look...he left me with the kid alone.”

“Poor Uta, all alone with a kid...what ever shall you do? Should we leave her with Nico or Itori instead?”

“Nico has a soft spot for kids actually...”

“Does he...?” I don’t know why it came as such a surprise, but it did.

“The kid will be okay...she’ll grow up strong.”

“Like you?” I asked somberly, crawling onto the couch next to him. Reaching out I gently placed my hands under

his chin, cupping his jawline and guiding my face close to his. Pressing my forehead to his I murmured:

“...you shouldn’t have had to be strong. You were just a kid...You should have been protected and loved.
## Always...”

## “ Ms. Aika! ”
I pulled away from Uta, drawn to the child’s voice as she ran out into the room. Tsubame was running around the
room again. The shorts were a little big but they stayed up with the drawstring tie. The shirt seemed to fit perfectly
though; the graphic reading ‘PUNK’ in all caps withstanding.

“Good they fit good enough for ya! Where’s your dress...did you forget it? Bring it here. I’ll try and wash it for
you.”

“OH! I forgot! I’ll get it!”
And...she was running off again.

“Ai-chan...” I cut him off by pressing my lips to his quickly.

“I love you...but I’ve also got to talk with you Uta. Don’t think you’ve gotten out of it because of all this—” I
glanced at him from the corner of my eye as I got off the couch. “—We’ll talk. When there’s not a five year old
running around the apartment...”


## ♥

The girl watched me do everything even after Uta left to go work on stuff in his shop.
She stood like a little (noisy) sentinel as I cleaned her dress and hung it up. She watched me clean up the blood
from the floor, the blankets and my shoes. She watched me cook my own food and made faces when I ate it.

It smelled funny. Of course it would to her.

“If it smells funny, why aren’t you laughing!!!” I dropped my dish off on the table and turned to the child,
tickling her sides until she screamed with giggles. Wiggling away she ran around the apartment for several minutes
giggling.

She ran down the stairs to the shop and my smile faded a little. Looking at the meal I’d made made my stomach
turn. I’m not really hungry, I just made it because I figured I should eat.

Abandoning it, I tossed the cooked sausage to Bjorn and went after the child. When I got into the shop I saw Uta
bent over his work. But no little ghoul girl.

“Uta...where’s Tsubame?”

A soft giggle came from under Uta’s desk.

I saw Uta glance up from his work, meeting my eye and then going back to the mask in his hands. Ohhhhhhh! So
that’s what was happening!

“Tsu-ba-meeee! Where are you hiding!? Is it...HERE!?” I pulled open a cabinet door and peeked in. “Awww!
She’s not here!”

Playing the game I guessed wrong over and over. The places became more and more ridiculous each time I guessed.
The game only paused for a few seconds when Nico stepped into the shop. He took a seat and crossed his legs,
watching as I continued:

“How about here!?”

I pulled open a small little drawer and sighed with exaggerated disappointment; keeping up the act.

“...I guess I lost her. She’s gone. Lost...”

I let my body slide to the ground and laid out flat on the floor. “I guess I’ll just die!~ Bleh—” I stuck out my
tongue to one side and played ‘dead’. Nico chuckled softly as he watched the display and I didn’t have to wait long
for the little girl to pop her head out from under Uta’s desk.

“NO! Ms. Aika! I’m right here!!! Don’t die!”

Sitting up quickly I grabbed the girl around the waist, stood and spun her around. “Gotcha!~”
I spun her around a few times, set her back down and then started walking around with an exaggerated wobble in
my step.

All to keep the girl laughing and smiling; for as long as possible. If Nico brought bad news; I didn’t want to hear it
either. I glanced again at the fem man and tried to read his expression. He caught the look and smiled.
“...If you're done clowning around, Dear. Do you want to hear the good news?”

“She’s alright!”

“...Ma'am!? Where is she!?” Tsubame’s face lit up and I saw tears starting to form at the corners of her eyes. She
must be so relieved. I felt the same after holding out on my fragile hope.

“On her way, little one! She’ll be here any minute...it seemed such a shame to stop your little game though. I was
enjoying it!”

“SEE! I told you little bird!~”




Not a second too soon the shop door opened and the bell tolled. Itori stepped in first, followed by Renji and then
finally the woman I remembered from months past. “Tsu!? Oh my god, Tsu! You're okay! I thought—”

I watched as the mother and daughter ran to each other and tucked themselves to each other; gripping hard and
sobbing.
The woman was saying thank you; over and over.
I leaned against Uta’s desk and smiled as tears gathered in my eyes before I wiped them away. Relief.

I was still so filled with relief.


“Thank you...Uta-san. Please...If there’s anything I can do—”

“But mommy! Ms. Aika is the one who saved me! She made the bad man stop chasing me.” Tsubame interrupted
her mother and pointed at me.
I didn't know what to do but to lift a hand and wave.

“...you might not remember me...I’m so glad you're safe. Tsubame missed you.” I said quietly.

“You...but your...Human.”

“She’s a nice human though! She played games with me and gave me food and cleaned my dress! She gave me these
clothes! And she smells really nice mommy!”

I don’t expect any outpouring of gratitude, it was enough when the woman’s eyes teared up as she looked at me. It
was enough that she could only quietly whisper her thanks. It was even okay if she wanted to give Uta the credit.

The two left happy. Safe. Alive.

## ♥



“For someone who doesn't want kids, you do really well with them, Aika Dear!~ I saw you playing with her and
clowning around! It was quite cute!~”

“I never expected U-kun to handle having a kid running around so well either. You two might have to reconsider!~
I think it was rather adorable how she clung to you, Aika-chan!”


I blushed and shook my head quickly. “Just because I handled a kid for a few minutes...doesn't make me parent
material!!! I can be...a babysitter if any of you have kids! How about that!?”

I tried shrugging off Nico and Itori’s comments. It was natural to want to protect a child, wasn’t it? As cute as the
child was I couldn’t imagine feeling committed to something’s safety like that all the time. It would consume my
thoughts every waking moment. If something like this happened to my own child...I couldn’t imagine what havoc
I would have wrecked.

Besides, it’s not like Uta and I had been being very careful. Since the chance was so astronomically low, and the
result wasn’t likely to make it past a few weeks...

“Uta did really well though! I hope she didn’t pull too much on your piercings, did she?” Leaning over Uta’s chair
I gently touched the piercing on his brow and traced a finger over his ear.

“No. She didn’t pull...”

“That’s good. I’d have to poke more holes in you if she yanked them out!~” I teased and giggled when he tilted his
head up to look at me.
“I want some more...” He touched a part of his ear that wasn’t already decorated and I smiled.
“Next you’ll be asking me to pierce your nipples or your—”

A throat cleared and I turned my head, a blush spreading across my cheeks when I remembered we had guests.
Itori, Renji and Nico had all been out all night. Even though Itori and Nico both wore some make up I could see
they had darker bags under their eyes. Their clothing was a bit scuffed and there were spots that looked
suspiciously like blood splattered on them as well.

A quick glance at the clock told me it was nearly sunrise...

“Thank you for looking for her mother...you were out all out looking all night, weren’t you? I’m sure they’re
Doves all over the 14th ward now, aren't there. Were you guys hurt?” It wasn’t truly a question. After one was
killed it was almost sure to happen.

“Aww! You were worried about us!”

“Of course! You're my friends...” That should have gone without saying; I thought at least.

“We’re fine. But they swarmed the area...Barely got my bar closed in time. I think I’ll leave it closed for the week
just to be on the safe side.” Itori sighed, planting her hands on her hips and added: “You made quite the mess,
Aika-chan. They’re making quite a lot of racket about a ‘ghoul in a deer skull mask’. They knew you were
connected to Uta. Probably from the last time you two ran afoul of them...and now they’re already trying to come
up with a name for you!”


“A...name?”

“Like No-Face. Or Big Sister. And Raven.” Itori pointed out Uta, Nico and then Renji.
“Roma is Gypsy.” She added helpfully.

“...Touka and her brother both go by ‘Rabbit’ and ‘Black Rabbit’.” Renji spoke up.

“Aren’t those names you picked for yourself...? I’m a bit scared to ask...what are they calling me.”

“Some of them are terrible at naming, Dear. There’s been a few floating around that have been absolutely criminal:
‘Prong’, ‘Buck’, ‘Skull Face’.” Nico scoffed.

“I’ll have to look into it and see if I can find an updated ranking book before the auction. But most of them seem
to be calling you Wendigo . Something about the mask reminded one of them of some myth.” Itori added.


My mouth opened a little and despite myself; I laughed.Wendigo was a good name for a Ghoul. Really good.

“If I’m honest I don’t hate it. And you shouldn’t call me by my name when we’re running around in masks...I
guess I don’t get to pick.”

“We really shouldn’t be calling you by your name. Probably should have thought of that sooner. But you don’t
have to go by what they call you. We’ll call you something else if you want.”

“It’s not that it’s a terrible name. They can call me that if they want. But with friends, how about—” I glanced at
Uta and considered. “...How about we just shorten it. Wendy.”

“Wendy?”

“Yeah.” I smiled faintly. “Like...Peter Pan. ‘Wendy with the Lost Boys’...”

A human among ghouls.
Uta was my Peter Pan.

## Notes:

## WELP!

Yup. So I have planned her ghoul name since I started writing this.
Wendigo/Wendy!!!
Also, hope ya'll enjoyed her being silly with the kid :3
## WE NEEDED SOME LIGHT HEARTED STUFF





## Chapter 61: The Talk



The other Ghouls were gone.
They’d left soon after sunrise. Right after I’d announced my new name. The shop was closed for business today.
Everyone needed rest. Even if I napped for a short time with the child...I could use some knock out dead sleep. So
it left me alone with Uta once more.

“Whose mask is this...?” I leaned over his shoulders and watched him as he put the materials aside for the night.
“You’ve been working on it pretty fervently tonight.”

“Yours. After I’ve finished it. It’s just the start of it.”

“Really? Can I see the sketch?”

“No. It’s a surprise.”

I pursed my lips and then with a small sigh I nodded. “Alright. Alright...You know I do like surprises...”

—Speaking of surprises.

“Except...not all the time. There’s some things you shouldn’t surprise me with Uta...like an auction . For
example...”

I had the ghouls attention. He turned his chair around so that he was facing me. His eyes were fixed upon my face.

“I’m going to have questions, so come upstairs. Are you hungry? I’ll cook you some breakfast and we can talk over
food.”

He seemed to think about it. “I’m not that hungry. I think I’ll just grab a snack for now....”

“Eyes?” Uta’s mouth twitched. Almost had a smile there .
“Eyes it is!~ I’ll get a dish of them for you. Come on up—you’ve been up all night. After we chat we can—” I
paused and yawned.

“...ugh. Then we can both go to bed. And you can eat anything that interrupts our sleep...”

I was halfway up the stairs before Uta spoke again. “You promise?”

“Hum...Unless it’s one of your friends. Or Kazu. Or Amon...sure.”

“Amon is on the list?” Uta stood from his chair and began to follow me, turning off the lights in the shop on the
way.

“...It would be really suspicious if he disappears since he knows me. And people at the CCG know he knows me. If
he tells anybody he’s going to be in the 4th...and then poof. Missing? Might be strange...Plus, despite being an
investigator he has been rather kind. I would prefer it if he didn’t die. Okay?”

Uta caught up behind me by the time I got to the top of the stairs and entered the apartment behind me.
Bjorn’s head shot up and I called for him. The giant dog bounced up from his spot on his bed and excitedly
proceeded to ‘attack’ me by butting his head into my stomach and wiggling ‘aggressively’.

“Oof! Alright! I know, I know! I completely neglected you when the kiddo was here! You get lots of pets now.
Lots and lots. And FOOD !”

I laughed as the dog's ears perked and he backed off to spin and bounce around the room like he was a puppy.
I grabbed Bjorn’s food out of the fridge and put it in his bowl and then pulled out the glass jar from the back of
the fridge that held the eyes that Uta loved so much.

Carefully with a ladle (one specifically kept for this) I took out half a dozen eyes of various colors. I didn’t look at
them too hard before putting away the jar and bringing them out to the ghoul lounging on the couch.

“Here you are!~” I placed the dish into his outstretched palm and then crawled onto the couch. I heard the soft
intake of air as I crawled up against him; leaning my head on his chest and fitting my body under his other arm.
It didn’t take more than a few moments for him to shift us so we were both comfortable. His free arm wrapped
around my middle with his hand on my hip; fingers subconsciously rubbing at some exposed skin.


The dish of eyes were set, balanced on his leg so he could carefully pick them up and bring them to his mouth. I
closed my eyes, nuzzled next to his collar bone and relaxed as he carefully ate the eyes. I could hear his chew and
swallow, and the faint sound of his heart beating a few inches from my head.

“So...Why didn’t you tell me about the Auction sooner?” The shock had worn off. Or else, maybe everything else
had dulled the surprise of it all. Now I just have questions. I had to know why...

The fingers at my hip stopped for a moment before gripping tightly and relaxing. His heartbeat picked up a few
beats and he’d stopped eating.
Was he nervous? He wasn’t talking though, so that was a problem. I moved my hands, wrapping my arms around
his muscled torso and smoothing my palms over his skin. The ghoul seemed to relax under the attention and he
started to eat another eye, the hand on my hip started massaging the flesh again.

“I knew you wouldn’t like it.”

“There’s a lot of things I don’t like.” The ghoul went quiet after that so I kept talking. “Uta...you do know just
because I don’t like something you do, or that happens around you because of Ghouls; it doesn't mean I don’t like
you. It’s not difficult to love you...”
I breathed out and pressed my lips to his throat, just under the ‘ποσσυμ’.

“I wanted to tell you after we went to the club. But you got hurt and were upset after that night...” I peeked out of
one of my eyes and saw he was licking an eye rather than eating it again. Smiling faintly I re-closed my eye.

“Right...how about we start there. What was that? You swallowed the man almost whole.”

“My Kakuja. You might call it an evolution. We absorb RC cells from things we eat, so because of cannibalism my
body has a higher RC count than most. I don’t use it often...”

Okay, we were getting somewhere now.
“Okay. That makes sense. If your Kagune is made of RC cells then having more gives you a bigger and more
extensive form. But you seemed more...” Wild? Unpredictable? Unleashed?

“He hurt you and you’re mine. I had to kill him.”

“He also figured out I was Human. Before you—you know. I know he had to die. Maybe next time we won't
moan into our food...?”

The ghoul chuckled a bit despite the topic. “Why not? You do.”

“What—” My face heated up as a blush took over. “I absolutely do not!”

“You do.” Uta insisted; I could hear the smirk on his face as he placed the eyeball in his mouth and moaned just to
mess with me. “...and you do a little dance sometimes too when it’s something you really like.”


“Stop! I know you’re lying!”

“I’m not...it’s adorable.”

“That’s it. I’m never eating in front of you again.”

The ghoul laughed aloud and finished off the rest of his snack. He held me tight around the waist as he shifted to
reach to the coffee table to put down the shallow dish.
When he returned to laying on the couch he moved his feet up and shifted us so I was practically lying on him.
Holding me so he could wrap both arms around me and bury his nose into the crux of my throat and inhale.

I let him and settled to wrap my arms around his head and shoulders.

“...Tell me about the Auction. What do you do there? Why do you like it? Where...where do the Humans come
from? What happens after they’re bought?”

Uta took a moment to think before speaking but when he did, he spoke gently. And at length.

“There’s some Ghouls that like to capture Humans to sell. For money if they need it. Or sometimes for fun.
‘Specialty’ Humans mostly. Actors. Famous people. Politicians. But also ones that smell particularly delicious.
They’re kidnapped and taken alive to the Auction...and sold to the highest bidder. Mostly the richer Ghouls play
the game. Most of the audience there is just watching the spectacle or the ones who are selling the items. As for
what they’re used for after—Food. Toys. Play things. It varies.”

“And you play the auctioneer? Why?”

“The Clowns entertain. We make it fun.” He paused and I waited patiently. “Surely it’s not so hard to understand
that some revenge might feel good...? After everything you know they do to us...”

I could. I could at least see how he and others would feel that way. Even if I couldn’t feel it myself right now.
“When I go with you...Do I need to be anywhere near the—the ‘items’?”

“No...Not if you don’t want to. I’ll stay off the stage. With you. Nico is right. You’d be safer.”

“And my scent?”

“I’ll make sure you don’t smell like yourself.”

“That might be really hard, Uta...”

The ghoul grinned against my throat and then slid his tongue across the skin. “I can manage it. I’ll make sure of
it...even if it takes all night. You’ll smell just like me.”

My face flushed at the implication.

“That might not be enough...”

“...hum. I’m also going to ask some favors from Itori and Touka-chan. I’ll get your outfit scented by them. You’ll
smell like a female ghoul—covered with my scent. So everyone knows you are mine.”

It was a good idea. I supposed I’d have to trust that Uta and the others would have an idea of how to hide me in a
crowd of Ghouls. How to avoid their keen senses. “Before we go in we’ll double check with Nico. He’s got a keen
nose, right? And I’ll be glued to your hip, Uta. You best not leave me alone a single second. Not even if you need
to go use the restroom. I don’t want another case like the club...”

“I won’t...”

“They aren’t going to die at the Auction...right?”

“No. None of the ‘items’ are killed at the Auction. They’re collected backstage and go to their new homes.” That
was one way to say it.

“You know Uta...that if I wasn’t yours. If I was just Ms. Kaneshiro. Owner of Kogane no Shiro. There might be
Ghouls who would kidnap me and put me up for sale like them...” The hands around my waist gripped almost
bruisingly tight.

“I imagine being the only heir to a large company would put a target on my back for that sort of thing...”

“It would.”

“I’d be very valuable...How much do you think?” I whispered.

The ghoul inhaled my scent and continued to hold me tight to his body. “I’d never allow it.”

“Come on Uta. Name a price...”

“...I can’t.”

I smiled faintly. Entwining my fingers into his hair and gently pulling out the ponytail I held his head close to my
neck and chest. Good. That made me happy—I was priceless. At least to Uta.

“Just one more question...”
The ghoul hummed softly in the back of his throat, waiting on it to be spoken.

“Do you...do you bring ‘items’ to the Auction?”

“Once or twice. They were CCG officers. I thought it would be funny...”


“And...?”

“...And?”

“...was it funny?”

The ghoul paused once more, likely not expecting the question. He nibbled at my neck before answering. “...a
little bit. They thought help was coming. But it never did. I think they were kept as pets. By ‘Big Madam’...she
likes her pets.”


“When was the Auction again? Are you going to have my mask done by then?”

“I thought you said no more questions...”

I laughed softly–cutting off into a moan as he nibbled a bit harder on my neck. That really shouldn’t feel this good.
“Right. I’m sorry. You’re completely right. I did say no more questions. I guess you want to go straight to bed
then?”

“Not straight to bed...I wanted to tell you that your performance earlier was cute. We’ll have to play it sometime.”

“Hummm. You think so? I was just trying to make her happy. You did really well with the kid too!”

“I also recall you mentioning something about piercing my—”

“No! Uta! It was a joke!”


## ♥


I fell asleep with a smile on my face.  Lulled to sleep by a steady heartbeat. Nestled safely in Uta’s arms and curled
under the weight of blankets.

But when I woke I felt cramped.
Disoriented and squashed into a small space. It was pitch black and no matter how I flexed I couldn’t seem to push
the weight off me.
A box? The harder I pushed the smaller the space seemed to get.

“Uta...where are you?”

I flinched as I was suddenly dumped out onto a wooden floor; a spotlight suddenly on me. I held my hand over

my eyes to try and see. I was on a stage with a crowd of masked figures watching on.

“Pretty!” “Nice Frame! Look at her thighs!” “She smells delicious! I want to eat her so bad!”

An auction!? How did I get here! Where was Uta!?

## “LADIES AND GENTLEMAN! TODAY WE HAVE—”

I raised my hands over my ears so I couldn’t hear and felt tears dripping down my face.
This wasn’t real. It wasn’t real. It couldn’t be real. It just couldn’t...

He wouldn’t let this happen.
We had just spoken about this.
The auction wasn’t for at least another week.
It was a dream. A nightmare.

“But it is happening. Don’t you see? You are me! I’m you!”

I heard my own voice speak and looked up.
A ghoul was squatting down in front of me. My deer skull mask propped on her face. A pair of ghoulish eyes
stared out from behind the bone orbitals.

“Don’t you see? This is happening.”
I felt my doppelgangers hands around my throat, squeezing until I couldn’t breath. I grasped and failed to draw in
air; clawing and fighting to release myself.

Uta...save me. Please!

“Consider the ship of Theseus!"

## ♥

Uta woke up on edge again, arms gripping around his human.
She was whimpering again in her sleep. Fighting off monsters and bad memories. It would be nice to think that
she’d get over these after enough time with him. But they seemed to be getting worse.

“Uta...where are you?”

Today it seemed the monster wasn’t him.
Instead she was calling out for him to help her.

He had to exhale a few times and force his body to relax. Kagune settled and the vein-like lines in his eyes retreated.
Yet the woman still struggled in his grip, gasping and breathing irregularly as her nightmare fought her.

“ Uta...save me. Please!”


Her heart was beating so hard in her chest—and with her breathing coming in short little gasps and despite all his
control; he was scared. His mate was hurting and he couldn't do a thing to stop it—

“Aika. Wake up...wake up!” Uta sat up in bed. Leaning over her struggling body and gently shook her. “It’s not
real—”

A fist cracked into his nose and he felt the bone splinter under the pressure. His eyes were wide in the dark, veins
splintering out from the iris as blood dripped down his face. Aika’s hand still tried to claw and attack him. Her
eyes were wide and fearful; not recognizing him in the dark of the room. Grasping her wrists he placed himself
over her. Hands around her wrist and held on either side of her head.

“Ai-chan—!!!” He grunted as one strike from one of her knees struck between his legs. With a soft curse he let his
Kagune out, two of three limbs of it held down her legs to keep herself from kicking him again; or hurting herself.

“Aika. Ai-chan...it’s me.”

The woman breathing was still ragged and she fought under him, but slowly she was giving up.

“Please don't hurt me...I don’t want to die. Please...”

That now familiar feeling gripped him as she begged. She sounded so broken...
Was it a mistake to bring her further into his world? A mistake to show her all the cruelty of the world. But it’s not
like he forced her, right?

All he wanted was her to love him. Love him in spite of everything that should make her hate him.

“I’m not hurting you, Ai-chan...You’re safe. I’m going to let go of your hands now.”

## ♥

I felt my fist come in contact with something hard. Felt my hand bloom into pain. Yet still I fought. Kicking and
kneeing at the warm body over me. I had to fight—had to live.

I don’t want to die! Please!

I could hear Uta’s voice, but somehow I couldn't understand what was happening. Save me!

Only when the restraints were gone and the lights of the room were flipped on did I start to really know what had

happened. Uta stood by the light switch near the door. His eyes were wide, blood shot with his active Kakugan and
Kagune. The limbs twitched restlessly behind him.

And his face was covered in blood. Although the flow had already stopped and his nose looked normal it seemed
to have trailed from there.

“..Uta...Uta...I’m—I hit you? I’m...I’m so sorry. ”

“You had another bad dream. I thought waking you would help.”

ANOTHER bad dream? Has this happened before? I thought the one earlier was just me defending the child. But
what if these kept happening. What if one of these times I really hurt him?

“M-maybe...Maybe I’ll sleep on the couch. For a little while until the nightmares stop—”

“No. It’s okay Ai-chan...it’s just a broken nose.” I was about to argue when he wiped his face on his sleeve. “...I
won’t be able to sleep without you here. Remember?”

“Right but...” I stared at his Kagune which still hung around him. They twitched and moved and I wondered why
they were still out at all. “...I’m still sorry. Uta...I really am.”

“What were you dreaming of...? You haven't told me what your nightmares are...”

“I don’t remember most of them. So I guess I wouldn’t have mentioned them...tonight was.” I swallowed thickly
and shook my head. “...really vivid. I dreamed I was on a stage. Maybe it was supposed to be an auction. Even
though I’m not sure what they look like. Probably because we were talking about it earlier. But I—Myself was
there. She looked like a Ghoul...I—she wrapped her hands around my neck and was strangling me...”

I brought my hands to my neck and shivered.
What was that sort of thing supposed to mean anyway?

Uta returned to the bed, crawling in beside me. I glanced at his Kagune and reached out in one of the limbs'
direction. The ghoul’s extra appendage met my hand and curled around my body; pulling me back to his arms.
“You’re safe with me...”

“I know...I just...felt like I was dying. I needed to fight . I didn’t want to die...”


I relaxed against Uta, his Kagune wrapping and entwining around me like I was a fragile doll in a warm cocoon.
“Uta...you’ll get hungry if you keep this up for too long. Won’t you?”

“I’m okay for now.”


He’s keeping me safe. At least, I think that’s what he was doing. Regardless of the lights on...I was able to drift off to
some light sleep.

## ♥



Chapter 62: (Almost) time to go.
## 

## Notes:
(See the end of the chapter for  notes.)
## Chapter Text

Chapter 62: (Almost) Time to go.


Tomorrow was the Auction, and so far today Uta hadn’t moved far from my side at all.
From the time I’d gotten out of the shower in the morning onward. While he had never really cared much for
personal space he was being touchier than normal. In fact as the day went on I began to count myself lucky that he
allowed me from his grasp in the morning to shower at all.

He told me he had completed my mask, though he still wouldn’t let me see it. When I asked if he should be
working in the shop — he had told me it would be closed for a few days. Including today. He had plans .

“Ai-chan. I’ve got these for you.”
He held up a small plastic case and I peeked into the clear top. Ghoulish eye contacts stared back.

“Oh—I forgot. Are these really necessary though? You’re the only ghoul I’ve seen where they are permanent.
Where did you even find someone who would make these...?”

“You can’t change them on command. And they won’t change by accident...like ours do sometimes. There is
catering at the event...”

“So it would be strange if my eyes never changed once...wouldn’t it?” I sighed and took the little case from him. It
was better to be safe than sorry, especially in this case.

“You want me to try them on...?”


“You should try and get used to them a little before the auction.”

“Yeah...” By the looks of them they were quite large, covering all the white of my eye as well as making them red to
match Uta’s. “Alright, alright! I’ll try them on. You’re just looking forward to seeing me with ghoul eyes; aren't
you?”

I went to the bathroom, washed my hands first and then with some trepidation popped the top of the contact
container. They were intimidating to try and get into my eye and the fact that Uta was hovering at the doorway
watching me was distracting.

“Uta— shoo! Go sit down. You're making me more nervous... I’ll be out in a minute.”

I waited until he was gone and then took another calming breath. Okay...
Time to get ghoulish .

I struggled at first getting the first eye in. Blinking and fighting back tears. It wasn’t comfortable at all but it also
didn’t exactly hurt.

I didn’t look in the mirror with just the one in. I wanted to see them both before I saw them at all. Once I had
them both in I held my eyes closed for several minutes; moving them left, right, up and down over and over until
the movement felt smoother and got more comfortable.

I opened them, dropped some saline solution into my eyes and blinked them some more to move the liquid
around. Looking around the bathroom I immediately noticed the limitations of my vision. The peripheral of my
vision was cut off and what I could see was dimmed except for a tunnel straight forward.

I moved myself in front of the mirror and looked up; straight into the eyes of a ghoul. I couldn’t help but softly
gasp as I watched the ghoul’s eyes go wide with shock. Me . My eyes go wide.

It brought back memories of that ghoulish-self in my dream. Now when I raised my hands to my face the ghoul in
the mirror did the same. Freaky .

I’d have to wear them for a while to get used to them so I supposed I’d be wearing them today. It was a good thing
I’d asked Yoshimura for a long weekend because these would be terrible to wear out and about; let alone work.

I washed and dried my face, glancing one more time at my reflection before stepping out of the bathroom.
“Well...I got them in.”

The ghoul was on the couch, hand on the remote to the TV. He turned his gaze towards me as I rounded the
corner. His hand held the remote aloft, fingers hovering over the buttons to change the channel from a news
channel to the next.

His own ghoulish eyes were widened, giving me that huge doe-eyed expression of his.


“Uta-kun...?”

He placed down the remote and stood up. At my side quickly, his hands cupped my face gently as he gazed at the
contacts. “...They look alright? I can’t see very well at the moment.”

“You look good Ai.”

I smiled faintly and took his hands in mine, holding them about where my vision stopped. “Maybe they look good.
But for me everything looks pretty bad. I can’t really see past here....or here. There’s a tunnel straight forward
where I can see clearly. Everything outside of it is kind of dimmer. A little blurred. If I were a Ghoul, I’d be a ghoul
with very bad vision...I definitely can’t fight like this.”

“Mmm. Maybe we should have tattooed your eyes instead...”

I scoffed, laughed and gently shoved him. “ No way ! That sounds painful! Plus it would make working at the cafe
impossible. Do you know how weird that would be—You get away with it here and you are lucky nobody has
found out yet!”

“I like it.” Uta spoke softly. His hands were already back on me, pulling my body close to his by my hips. “All
that’s left is to make you smell like me..."

“A-and how do you suggest we do that?”

“There’s a couple options...” Uta was walking me slowly backwards, towards the bedroom as he spoke. “I could
cover you in some of my blood.”
I grimaced at the idea. “Next.”

“I could try to get you pregnant. Your scent may change—.”

My eyes widened at the suggestion. “ But—”

“It hasn’t happened yet and we don’t want kids—” Or a miscarriage as the case may be. “My favorite method
would be keeping you in my bed all day with me.”

“What would we do all day in your bed, Uta? It could get boring~”

I was pressed up against the wall between the hallway and his room a moment later after speaking. His lips were
pressed against my throat as he spoke.
“Boring? I could make it less boring for you Ai. If you want.”

Shivering I lifted my chin up, letting him lick and nibble up my neck to his heart's content.
“If we’re being adventurous, when are you going to let me tie you up, Uta-kun!? You wouldn’t happen to have any
Quinque steel handcuffs somewhere, would you?”

He pulled away and stared ; probably trying to see if I was serious or not.


I raised an eyebrow under his scrutiny. “...You said all day . I’ve got plenty of ideas of what we could do. They
don’t all have to be sex. If you don’t want them to be.”

“I do.”

“You do want it all to be sex? I might need a break or two if we’re doing that. And you’ll have to carry me around
the auction. That might be suspicious.”

“No, I mean I have handcuffs. Somewhere...but we can’t use them.”

I blinked and raised an eyebrow. I didn’t think he had an issue trusting me to use them on him. And certainly he
could probably break them even if they were Quinque steel. So what was the problem?

“...the bed frame is wood.” He answered, reading my expression.

“Ah—” The bed frame is wood! That’s his excuse!?

“Well...I wonder how much one made entirely of that steel would cost. Even if I can’t find Quinque steel I’m sure
I could get something that’s at least a little stronger than wood.” I smirked as his eyes went impossibly wider.

"I don't think even you could afford that much of their steel. They might question why you need so much of it..."

“—Anything to stop my boyfriend from breaking the bed. Actually I wanted to ask you something. But it could
be rude. Or at least maybe just in poor taste..."

## Hum?”

I could ask. Uta probably wouldn’t even mind the question; even if the answer was no. At most he’d probably find
it funny. Knowing that, I could manage to mutter the question quietly. Though I couldn’t meet his eyes.

“Have you—I mean could you...or is it common. Or—”

Shit. How do I say this?

“...Do ghouls ever...use their Kagune for anything other than hunting? Or moving around? Like—”


“—during sex?” Uta finished my thought.
He lifted me up, pressing my back against the wall firmly and I wrapped my legs around his waist. He went right
back to my neck and shoulders.

“Do you want me to, Ai?”

“You don’t have to. I-I wasn’t sure if it was s-something you ever thought of. Or...if it was something you avoided
because you didn’t want to scare me.”

“Have you thought about me using it?” Uta smirked against my throat as he kept grazing his teeth against the
junction between my neck and shoulder.
There was a scar forming there, from each bite that was left. Two crescents made teeth impressions.

“...I—that’s not f-fair. I asked first!”

“It would help me get my scent on you faster.” He glanced over his shoulder into the living room where Bjorn was
staring at us.

“Best....go to the bedroom. Before he decides to bite you, Uta. I’m sure it’s a worse bite than mine!~”

Uta smirked faintly, pulled me away from the wall and began to walk us into the bedroom. Shutting the door and
Bjorn out behind us.

I bounced when he dropped me unceremoniously on the edge of the bed. I unhooked my ankles from around his
back and scooted back; watching as he took off his shirt. He tossed it aside into a pile that I would probably begin
washing after we got back from the Auction. A second later I could see the RC cells in his back bubble up and
form his Kagune.

“I suppose...with the density of RC cells it would make sense that your scent would be really concentrated in your
Kakuhou.” I still marveled at him when he did this. Even if he’d caught me countless times off the roofs. Even if he
held me tightly in his arms with them. Even if he used them to keep me safe in bed and lull me to sleep.

He double checked the bedroom window. Its blinds were closed before he crawled up onto the bed after me as I
wiggled backwards so we fit comfortably. The extra limbs seemed to help him keep his balance. Instead of placing
his hands on either side of me to keep himself propped up, Uta leaned on the Kagune and used his more dexterous
hands to slide under the hem of my shirt and start to pull off clothing.


I found myself counting the tails. Two to lean on. A third moving up my legs, pushing them apart so he could fit
his hips between my thighs. A fourth was idly caressing my side after he removed my shirt up over my head. They
were pleasantly warm as always. Despite looking a little rough with pockets and divots in the surface they slid over

He stopped and caught my gaze. I studied his own eyes for a moment; the crackling splintery veins sprouting from
the center of his red irises and spreading out even to the skin around his eyes.

“...Are you okay Ai?”

“Hum?...Of course.”
"You're staring Ai-chan..."

"Of course I'm staring." Raising a hand I cupped the side of his face and smiled fondly. My legs wrapped around
his waist and pulled him close as I could. Hooking my heels on his back, just under the junction of his back and
## Kagune.

"How could I not...?"

The fourth limb of his Kagune began to shift again, caressing up my side once more. The deadly hook at the end
brushed the pillow near my head. Because of the contacts I had to turn my head to see it, but once I did I moved
my other hand to gently touch it. Wrapping my hand around the junction between ‘claw’ and muscle and
bringing it towards my cheek.
Meeting his gaze again I nuzzled gently against it. The bladed end twitched and curled, only grazing my skin
harmlessly.

We were going to have some setbacks. But I'd prove that he didn't scare me; one tiny act of acceptance at a time.
"You are beautiful to me."

“...I’m just curious.” I shot him a devious little smirk before sticking out my tongue and rolling it across the
outside of muscle I had near my face.
To my delight licking him like that had quite the effect! I heard the quick intake of air and his body shuddered
and twitched. His Kagune; both the part I licked and the others, curled and straightened a few times.

“Ticklish?”



I let go of his face and his Kagune, gathering his two hands and bringing them to my throat. My pulse beating
steadily in my arteries under his fingers.

"Uta...It’s nice that you check on me. But you don’t have to keep reassuring me. I am well aware you are capable of
profound violence. You can be savage and even act cruelly."

I couldn't and wouldn't doubt those things about him. I’d seen some of it first hand. I couldn’t make excuses for
him, nor do I think I should. "—But I also know you are just as capable of immeasurable gentleness.” And
kindness. Love. Care.


As I spoke, Uta's Kagune coiled around me. Two against my legs and coiling around them to make sure I was held
tightly to him. Two more; one on either side kept him propped up. A fifth wrapped around my own waist, lifting
my back off the bed a little. Finally a sixth cradled my head, neck and shoulders. Six. All six?


His ghoulish body was built to hunt and eat Humans. It was supposed to be a weapon. It should feel dangerous.

## But—

His Kagune WAS part of him. As much as his other limbs. His arms that carried me. His mouth that spoke to me.
His beautiful eyes which gazed at me across a room just to watch me. Or the fingers he drew his works of art with;
currently wrapped around my throat where I’d placed them.
They’ve warmed my body in the cold, saved me from falls and comforted me in the worst of times. So even
cradled in the grip of his ghoulish ‘weapon’ I couldn’t help but feel safe and relaxed.
Even if - slowly I was realizing that with the grip he currently had on me was restraining. I couldn’t move all that
much and he had the strength to keep me stuck if he wished it.

Moreover, it seemed like he did wish it. Save for my arms which he allowed freedom. I kept them on him for now;
resting on the supports that kept him propped up.

Uta’s hands shifted his fingers so they hovered over my pulse. Feeling the steady beat and then moving them away.
They squeezed over my shoulders and down my sides. I exhaled a soft moan and tilted my head back, leaning into
all of his touch.


“Mmmm...this feels nice. If this is what you want to do all day then I’d be happy to!~”

## 


The ghoul growled and ground his hips into me. It was all I needed to know that simply snuggling up in his
Kagune was not what he wanted then!

I smirked. “I suppose not!~ Uta-kun! You’ve got to cover me in your scent...might as well get to wo—”

One of the kagune wrapped up my leg curled between me and the ghoul, slipping under my pants and ripping
through them. “Hey!!!” I flexed under the grip but found absolutely no give.

“You can try Ai-chan. But that’s not going to get you very far.” I heard the teasing in his voice and spotted the
smirk on his lips.
“...Maybe but it can’t hurt to try! Especially if you're going to rip all my clothing!”

“You’re welcome to try and stop me.”

He continued ripping the pants off. Tugging the scraps off me with a tail of the Kagune while his hands explored
my torso, unclasping my bra and cupping my breasts since his hands were otherwise unoccupied. I flexed again.
My new muscles strained to push him away enough that I might be able to rescue my underwear from the same
fate.


Sadly, the muscular form wrapped around me tightened and any movement I managed to wiggle in stopped
instantly as I was caught in a vice grip. With a flick, a bladed tip sliced through fabric and pulled it away from my
body.

“I liked that pair.” I whined softly. “Those were the ones with the black lace flowers!”

“I like them better over there...” The ghoul growled, his voice growing low and gravely as he lowered his face. His
Kagune lifted me further to meet him in the middle so his teeth could scrape my shoulders with new marks that he
would sooth over with his tongue.

“Don’t struggle too much, Ai-chan. I have to try to be gentle with you today.”

“I don’t see you ripping your own pants off.” The ghoul shifted me, letting my torso arch backwards towards the
bed while he fought with his own pants.

I chuckled softly at the effort, but in the end he did end up ripping them. From the sounds of it they were
probably still salvageable. Unlike mine.

“You’re normally so patient Uta—Are you so different with your Kagune out?~”

The ghoul didn’t reply, instead he pressed his hardened member against my core. One of his hands was already
working to get the angle correct while his Kagune slipped around to wrap tightly around my upper thighs, pulling
my legs further apart and holding them out at a wide angle. I gasped and mewled softly as he rubbed the head of
his cock against me, using the natural lube to wet himself.

The ghoul pressed himself forward slowly. Painfully slowly sinking into me with a moan.

“Careful better not mean slower than sin!” I growled, digging my nails into the Kagune.
He chuckled darkly before grabbing my wrists and pressing me down to the bed. He pulled almost all the way out
and held me there: hovering ominously.

“It means, whatever I have to do not to break you.”

Whatever he had to do. That sounded delicious.

“I can’t help but to tease you, Uta!~ After all, all you're letting me move right now is my arms and my mouth! I
have to use the—”

My eyes went wide as the Kagune tail near my head curled around my head, covering my mouth. It shifted and
flexed so it cut off my voice without cutting off my breathing through my nose.

I moved my hands to the appendage and gripped it, though it didn’t move or give any. A moment later I made a
mistake; opening my mouth to lick the appendage in an attempt to dislodge it. It slipped into my mouth, acting as
a gag as the ghoul chuckled darkly.


I nibbled and bit the appendage; drooling around it as Uta pushed himself back in. Nice and slow until he was
hilted again. “ Good—that feels good Ai-chan .”

I moaned and arched as he kept going SLOW. Steady. But so slow...
Clenching my teeth around him made the ghoul gasp and growled and snapped his hips more roughly. Under the
restraints I squeeked, watching the ghoul’s eyes as he stared down at me .

With the branches of his Kagune around my thighs he pulled and pushed my body along with the sway of his hips.
With my noises largely silenced and reduced to muffled moans and squeaks I could hear so acutely the sound of his
breath as it went ragged.

The way the growling and groaning rumbled through his chest.

My hands finally found a home on his sides; right behind his shoulders. They clawed into flesh there as a tightness
in my belly coiled up and brought me closer to cumming around him.
I couldn’t tell him with my words but undoubtedly he understood when my vocalizations grew louder and my
walls began to clench around him.


## 


## ♥

I was flushed pink in the face as the Ghouls standing around Uta’s shop were staring at me. It could have been any
number of reasons to be completely honest.

It might have been because I was all dolled up in a clown-ish dress that I had to admit looked rather good ; polka
dots aside.

Or the new mask. Its ram horns were impressive and the half face seemed to resemble Uta's no-face mask.

The ghoulish red and black eye contacts would have also been a decent guess.

All that aside; I knew it must be because I was drenched in Uta's scent. There was no question that I was his. In
fact I really doubted anybody would question that particular fact for a long time.

“That’s certainly a way to tell others that you’re off limits~” Nico commented with a chuckle.

“You got something from another female ghoul on her? That one from the cafe?” Nico added, glancing at Uta
with a soft smile. “Mixed with Itori’s it definitely isn’t easily recognizable. It might do the trick. You certainly
dolled her up just like us. You fit right in, Darling!~”

Roma was sitting on Uta’s chair, spinning it around in circles. The moment she walked into the shop she had been
stifling a look on her face like she had smelled something sour. Apparently the idea that Uta fucked me was
disgusting to her.

I glanced at Uta, noting his outfit was that outlandish zebra suit. “...I wondered where the hell you wore that.”

“It looks good, doesn't it?”


“It...looks—It fits you really well U—No-Face.” I corrected myself. I’d have to get used to using the name from
the time we left the building. And since everyone was already wearing their masks...

“Mmmm. You don’t like it, Wendy?”

I glanced over him once again, running my eyes from head to foot and back.
“It does suit you. Somehow...You do pull it off well. I’ll give you that!”

“Oh! Speaking of you, Wendy!” I turned my gaze towards Itori, her mask was a huge grinning full face mask with
sharp teeth and the faces of cards played into the front of it.
“Look what I got!” She happily exclaimed, holding up a thick book and waving it in the air.

“An updated wanted list...? What  did they add her to it!?”  I cast a sideways glance at the small ghoul and then
looked warily at the book in Itori’s hands. Wherever she got her info from had to be pretty good, to get her hands
on something like that.

“See! You got a B~ rank.” Itori flipped right to the page and slapped the book down on Uta’s work desk. “And
they put you next to No-Face! Here, here! Read the comments!”

“What!? How the hell did she even get a B rank?” Roma stopped spinning and leaned over the book.
“...Wendigo...B?”

My eyes were fixed on the picture they had in the book, right beside Uta’s masked face. And the comments they
had placed under both.


## Wendigo

Wendigo (F) seen often in the company of the known Ghoul, No-Face (M).
Subjects appear to be of similar age. Likely his mate. Be wary of engaging. Known associates of the Clowns.

Below that was a detail of the investigator I’d killed. As well as an account of the night on the bridge. The account
included a long list of dead under it.

## RC TYPE: UNKNOWN
## WARD: UNKNOWN

There was more but I’d stopped reading.

“What’s the B—with the squiggly mean?”

“It means they think you’re at least that strong.” Itori waved a hand. “It’s basically them saying they don’t know.
You didn’t show a Kagune...because you don’t have one. But they wouldn’t know that. So normally you’d only be
C. But since you killed an investigator, they can’t rank you C.”


“They count in influences too, Itori Dear~. Since they have her listed as—”

Nico paused, leaning over the book and reading it. “...as his mate. And with us. It makes sense. They don’t know
what to make of you yet.~”

“Right...”  I glanced back down at the book and saw Uta’s ranking. SS.
## Eh!? Seriously?

B wasn’t anything really to write home about was it...? But still, it was enough to make Roma grumble about it. It
was likely just having a human rank at all was annoying her.

Uta laid a hand on my shoulder and handed over my umbrella. “Wendy. Time to go.”
Right. Yes. It was, wasn’t it?

I’d eaten food earlier, haven brushed my teeth vigorously afterwards to make sure nobody smelled human food on me.
Bjorn was in safe keeping for the time being. Everyone was gathered. I was dolled up to play ghoul for a time. The only
thing left was to follow him...wherever he led me.

Place my life in his hands and trust him; and the rest of the Clowns for that matter.

I grasped my umbrella from his hands and held it at my side, slipping my other arm around his. Linking arms and
stepping close to his side.
“By your side.” I answered softly.
