however, licensed to be given in this way. This is a pity because oral absorption can be observed and is often equal to or greater than the
assumed absorption from the gut.’




## Chapter 78:
Chapt er   Text
## Chapter: 78

“Kazuha is a Ghoul? And Merlin is hospitalized with ROS...” I felt like the world itself was having another meltdown around me. All
while my stomach was absolutely trying to reject itself out of my body.  My head hurts. I feel too warm one moment and then too cold
minutes later. I wanted to pace the room but when I tried to get up and move my body just felt...weak and dizzy. I sank to the ground,
wrapped my arms around my middle and whimpered.

I don’t want to turn into a Ghoul.
Not right now.
Not here.

If it had to happen it should happen somewhere safer. Secure. Someplace where Uta could lock me in a room. Kazuha had the right idea
when he ordered Yuto to be placed in a real bedroom. He now took over the locked secure cage that my uncle had been confined in for
some time. I had given him the green light for him to get some of the fake organs. That was a safe way for it to happen—to get used to
being something new.

As for feeding him; The company could get away with feeding one Ghoul. One.
Uta wouldn’t be eating it anymore, not after what happened. Not until I had it fixed. So that means that Kazuha could eat. He could stay
innocent of murder at least. He could be a Ghoul that was innocent of having death on his hands.

It was the least I could do for him.

Kazuha didn’t need to be strong; he just needed to be able to keep doing his job.

He wanted to keep doing his job. Chickafuji mentioned that despite the situation Kazuha was still ordering around the staff from the
locked room. One of his first demands was that his deskbe brought down with all its paperwork.

“There’s...something wrong with that man.” I groaned softly.

“Hummm...He’s got focus and self-control.” I nibbled on my lip and nodded my head. If I wasn’t mistaken the ghoul actually sounded
impressed. Uta was right; Kazu must have been starving when he turned. I think Chikafuji would have mentioned it if anybody was
harmed. That meant that Kazuha hadn’t hurt anybody.

Uta moved beside me and I winced away; whimpering.

“Ai-chan...” He laid his hand on my shoulder and rubbed. “I’m not going to hurt you...”

“I know...but what if I hurt you?” I thought of what happened to my parents. My father ate some beloved staff, his own wife...
“What if the meds don’t work in time and I hurt you...? I don’t have good self control...”

“I know...” Uta said softly, leaning in close anyway. “I’ve seen the way you eat sweets. Especially brownies...you scarf them down.”

It would have been hilarious if I weren’t so worried about eating him.
“...If you take a bite out of me it would be okay. I’d forgive you because you wouldn’t mean to hurt me...” Hadn’t I said something like
that to someone else at one point? I looked up at Uta and bit my bottom lip to keep it from wobbling.

“Uta-kun...I don’t want to turn into a Ghoul...not right now.”  Not with the way the world was now. I couldn’t survive it like he could. I
couldn’t stomach hurting people!


“I know...come here.” Uta leaned down closer and wrapped his arms around me, pulling my body towards him. I wrapped my arms
around his shoulders and my legs around his waist. He lifted and carried me. Settling on sitting on the couch he cradled me with his
hands rubbed across my back. I could feel my stomach still protesting and trying to reject the medicine.

“Just concentrate on keeping that medicine down...Hey Ai-chan...?”

I hummed softly, too sick and too weak to do much else at the moment.

“I thought of a name...”

A name? For what...? I made a small humming noise again, hoping that I’d understand it if he just kept talking.

“Kamenashi...”

## Kamenashi...
## Oh.
Oh a name. For him—for us.

“...Uta Kamenashi and Aika Kamenashi...” I smiled faintly as I softly spoke the names. “Mmmm. I like it...” I nuzzled up closer to Uta’s
neck and swallowed down the feeling like I might vomit. “I’ll gladly be Ms. Kamenashi...”

## ♥


Uta held his mate to him, rubbing her back. It was very early in the morning and Aika had fallen asleep when he was sure that the meds
had worked. Up until she had begun to smell of the RC suppressant he had thought he’d failed at getting her back in time. Now, as the
new scent overtook her own he knew the drugs had absorbed into her body and crushed down the cells trying to take over. Perhaps just in
time.

He lifted her and moved slowly towards the bedroom, placing her down and pausing when she rolled over and groaned as if in pain.

The doctor's words had made him worry. Moreover it had made his skin crawl as he poured the powdered pill into her mouth. It would
hurt her. She would be in pain. Yet the alternative was worse...

Worse for her.
Worse for him too because she wanted to stay Human, and he wanted her to be happy.
They had decided that. Then some foolish human almost ruined it all...

He crawled into his side of the bed and moved to lay beside her, pulling her body to him and holding her tight. The smell of the RC
representing drugs was... unpleasant to his nose but he would suffer that for her.

He joked with her often about how he could eat her. He didn’t think he really meant it. Even if sometimes she was truly very tempting
...but now she truly smelled unappealing to him. The scent alone might be enough to dissuade all but the hungriest Ghouls from eating her.
Uta surmised if they tried they’d be poisoned and weakened by the substance she took to suppress her own ghoulish nature.

All there was left to do was see how she felt in the morning...

## ♥



Waking up was a nightmare. My head was pounding and my stomach was still in knots, but...

I didn't think I was having any cravings for human flesh. Actually I didn't crave anything. There was a metallic taste in my mouth and
my mouth was dry. It seemed not to be something I could swallow down or be rid of. Despite that it was a good sign that I didn’t crave
anything anymore.  Before I fell asleep I had wanted steak but now the thought of meat was actually kind of repulsing.

I know before I fell asleep that Uta said that Chickafuji had recommended rice, crackers and bread. Things that were bland. Even the
thought of eating those things made my stomach roll uncomfortably.

I slid out from under Uta’s arms and struggled out of bed. When my feet touched the ground I winced as my knees almost buckled out
from under me. After a moment taken to steady myself I walked across the room, feeling my muscles ache from every step—

These weren't the side effects, were they?

I shuffled out to the kitchen and stared at the food there. Toast...
I’d try toast...

I clicked the bread into the toaster and stood over it. I tried not to cry when the smell that waffed up from it smelled burnt . I knew that it
couldn’t be yet as I took the toasted bread from the toaster and brought it to my mouth—

I gagged at the bitter acrid taste that stayed in my mouth. I took a breath to try and calm myself. Okay...it’s okay. It’s okay. It’s okay.
Maybe some Jelly?

Barely breathing I grabbed jelly from the fridge and spread a lot of it over top and shoved it in my mouth.

Shivered at the unpleasant taste and paused chewing. The sweet jelly tasted like it had gone bad—it’s too sweet taste reminded me of a
rotting fruit. Slathered of course, on the acrid taste of the toast. It didn’t make any of it taste better. Grimacing, I forced myself to swallow
the bite. I dropped the toast onto the counter and began looking for something else; desperate for something to be the same. To be edible!

When Uta finally emerged from the bedroom looking for me I had gone through everything  I had in the apartment. I was sitting on the
kitchen floor, back to a cabinet in front of the sink. A mug of black coffee cradled in my hands. Another cup sat on the counter above
me—it tasted like burnt sugar in tar.

Uta looked over the mess in the kitchen. The discarded food scattered between several plates and then down at me, staring at the coffee
cup in my hands. He picked up the cup above my head and sniffed it and frowned. “Can’t drink it with sugar...?”

I shook my head silently and sighed.
“I knew this would happen...” That didn’t stop it from being depressing. I took a sip of the coffee and grimaced.

“Humm...? Plain coffee not good either, Ai-chan?”

“It wasn’t good to begin with...it tastes normal bad though. So there’s that.” I took another sip of it and grimaced again. “I need to visit
the manor...I need to see how things are holding together there. Update the doctor. Get—get a new reading on my RC cell count. Maybe
a health check. Find out how often I need to take that pill. I’ll keep them on me just in case. I want to see Kazu...”

“Okay.”


“I’ll have Merl—” No. Wait—Merlin wasn’t going to be able to get me anymore. He was laying in some bed, medicated and suffering
from ROS.

“—I’ll call and see if another driver can come get us. We need to check on Yuto too. Since it seems like Kazuha kicked him out of that
room...and maybe I can get my uncle to take him sooner? Can you talk to Renji, see when he can bring us back out to the countryside?”

The ghoul nodded and started to toss away food that I clearly wasn’t going to eat. I hadn’t eaten a lot, taking bites out of nearly
everything and then discarding it when it tasted gross. “Guess I know how it feels now huh...? Roma would be thrilled.”

Uta glanced down at me and frowned. “Perhaps you could try lemon...?”

I smiled faintly and nodded.
“Sure...” Tipping my coffee cup back and quickly drank the rest of the cup and climbed to my feet. “Uuugh...my stomach still isn’t
happy with me.”

“From eating the food...?”

“No...I don't think so. I think it’s still the meds messing with me. Kazuha said there were a lot of side effects...It’s fine. I don’t think I
turned Ghoul—right?” Would I even know? I don’t think I’d feel this weak though.

The ghoul smiled faintly and chuckled. “No Ai-chan...you're not.”

“Sorry...the lines are becoming a little thin, aren’t they?” I weakly smiled and shrugged. “Oh well...At least I don’t have to worry about
that anymore. You either. I know you’ve been asking me to check my RC cell levels for weeks now...”

Despite my words I felt like yet another thing was stolen from me. It was weird how attached I was to taste without really realizing it. All
the more reason why I had to make the human meat substitute taste decent.

Sure, I hadn’t wanted to force my friends or Uta to eat something that tasted bad; but now I selfishly didn’t want to be eating something
that tasted bad either.

## ♥

A driver I didn’t know appeared at our doorstep, waiting to escort myself and Uta to the manor. We rode in silence and I found myself
wishing for Merlin’s sense of humor and the way he’d sometimes pick at me. The way he’d be so blunt and forward. The way he called
Uta my ‘gentle-lad’. He was sweet—in a rather rough way. A bit like a second uncle after Hiroshi had gone away.

“Hey—Where is Merlin being taken care of?”

The driver didn't even turn their head and shook their head. “I do not know, madam.”

“Oh...okay.”

“Kazuha might though. But...as you know he has been occupied.” The man driving spoke softly. He was young and nervous. I could see
his eyes glancing at the mirror and back to the road a few times. He couldn't see past the glass between the front and back and it seemed to
make him nervous. “I—I’m Ruka, Madam...it’s nice to meet you.”

“Ruka...are you to be my new driver?”

“Yes Madam. If—if you don’t mind.” I smiled and chuckled softly at his tone.

“Sure Ruka...just watch the road and keep us safe, okay?”

“I will! I mean—Yes Madam!” The young man's face flushed and his eyes snapped back to the road. I sat back in my seat, faintly smiling.
Uta’s eyes were watching the young man from behind the glass and I raised a brow.
“Uta...”

The ghoul tore his eyes from the young man and focused on me. “Do you think you could make Kazu a mask for me? Maybe my uncle as
well?”

“Of course, I’d be happy to. I’ll have to measure him. Is he going to allow me in the room?”
That was a good question. From the sounds of it Kazuha had locked himself in the ‘ghoul proof’ room and was now working from there.
Presumably that meant that he was staying in there for everyone else’s safety.

“I guess we’ll see. I’d go in with you. I’d like to trust Kazuha. But I think...” I sighed and shook my head. “I think I’ve put myself in
enough danger, haven't I? If anybody goes into the room it should be you...by yourself. You’d be able to subdue him if anything went
wrong—without killing him please. And I don’t have to be there when you take measurements. My uncle on the other hand, will be easy.
We’ll just need to remember to bring measuring tapes. Did Renji say when he could bring us...?”

“He said any time would be alright. Just to send him a message and he’ll come get us.”

The vehicle pulled up to the gate and it slowly opened letting the car in. As we pulled up to the front the driver announced we had
arrived. “Thank you Ruka. You’re free to go back to what you were doing. If I need you again I’ll call for you.”

“O-of course Madam!”

I walked through the front door and glanced left and right to see if anybody was here to greet us. Instead a familiar voice played through a
intercom:

“Hello Madam.”

I looked upwards and then around. “What—”

“I had the staff hook some means for me to run the household from this room.”

“Intercoms? Cameras? Can you hear us? See us?”

“Yeah Madam.”

“And...Yuto?”

“He’s got a room on the second floor. It is near yours and the Sirs. Presently he is locked in it and the windows have been blocked just as a
precaution. I assume you have come to see what has happened...However I urge you to check on the boy first. He’s been asking for you
and Sir.”

For some reason it was strange hearing Kazuha sound so much like himself still after—after what had happened. He was a ghoul now but
he was still very much the same work-a-holic man.

“I—” I bit my lip and then nodded. “Alright, but we’re coming down to see you right after.”

“...I expect nothing less, madam.” I could hear the man's sigh on the other end of the intercom before it went dead. Hurrying, I rushed up
towards our room. It wasn’t hard to find out which one was Yuto’s as it had a staff member standing guard in front of it.


“Madam, Sir. Are you here to visit the child? Kazuha warned me you’d be here. You can go in.” He turned and swiped a newly installed
keycard pad and the door clicked open. I stepped forward, looking around the new room for the child carefully. It thankfully didn’t seem
too much like my old one. There were toys and games strewn all over as they had been hastily moved.

“Ms. Ai!!!” The boy shot across the room and hugged me around the middle tightly.
“Woah, careful kid. You’re gonna squeeze me to death...”

“You were gone for so long!”

“I am sorry...there was—some things happened.” I laid a hand on his head and gently ruffled his hair. “...It’s been a little longer than I
meant to stay away. Look at your hair. It needs to be trimmed again. The sides are getting longer again.”

“Are you okay, Ms. Ai?” The boy stared up at me with a small frown on his face and I tried to thin of a lie.
“...No. Not exactly. But I will be. Do you know why you were moved to this room?”

“Because Mr. Kazu turned into a Ghoul...is that going to happen to anybody else?”

“No—it..... maybe. But not for a long while, I'm hoping.”

I moved to sit down on the edge of the boys bed and smiled. “My family has a sort of predisposition to having too many RC cells develop
in our bodies. Which ends up turning us ghouls when we get older, you see? But I’m taking meds...Kazu and Merlin got into some
trouble, and there was an accident that caused this. But we’re taking care of it...”

“Is...Mr. Kazu gonna turn back into a Human?”

“....No. I don’t think so kiddo.”

“Is he gonna eat people? ” I knew I’d have to explain and I’d have to do it carefully. Yuto was a child, but not as naive and gullible as a
younger child might have been.

“No, no. Come here and sit down.” I patted the bed and waited until the boy came and sat down on it with his legs crossed in front of
him. “Kazu’s not going to eat anybody! The company I own makes fake organs for humans who are sick. We take the one that my
company makes which is healthy and you put it into the sick person and they get better. But Kazu is gonna eat some extra ones, and he’ll
never have to eat a real person. Isn’t that neat? He’ll definitely never eat anybody here. We’re going to go down and check on him.”

“If he’s not dangerous, why’d he lock himself in my room...?”

“Well...were you dangerous? You were in that room. It’s just for security. It’s a room that keeps things safe. People inside. And people
outside. I’m sure for right now he feels better about being in there...I would too, until I adjusted. Does that make sense?”

The boy thought about it and then slowly nodded. “He's the same old Kazu...don’t worry. We’re going to see about bringing you out to
meet my uncle soon though! Maybe even tomorrow?”

“He’s a Ghoul too...”

“Yeah...he is. But you know what? I grew up around him since I was a wee little kid and never even knew he was. I was very, very safe with
him. He’s outside the city far, far away from anybody who might want to hurt you—and he’s a Ghoul which means he can keep you
super safe. He’ll teach you to hunt and fish and you can run all over the woods. Doesn't that sound fun?”

The boy's face lit up and I smiled. “You’re gonna love my uncle...and he’s gonna adore you!~”

“Okay Ms. Ai...” He glanced at Uta and stared . “...Uta still eats people...?”


“Yeah...Uta does...”

“Just the bad ones.” Uta spoke up. “Bad Ghouls too...”

“Really? Bad Ghouls?” I stayed silent but looked at Uta as he nodded his head.
“Ones that try to hurt Ai-chan. Or me...” Or no doubt ones that got on his territory and stepped on his toes. So was the dynamics and
‘politics’ of Ghouls.

“Oh! They are bad!” I smiled faintly at the simplicity of a child. Of course, if someone tried to hurt someone else that made them bad .
“Alright kiddo...don’t worry. You won’t be cooped up much longer. We’ll get you some fresh air!”


Exiting the room we left Yuto to play his video games which had come up to the room with him. Walking back down towards the locked
‘ghoul cage’ I began to get nervous. How was Kazu? How was Merlin? How did any of this happen?

What happened at the lab? The security guards? The man who had thrown the sample?

I hurried my pace but quickly found myself out of breath. Uta stayed by my side, glancing at me when I was forced to slow right back
down. “Ai-chan...are you okay?”

“Just...out of breath. I don’t really feel good. Just... tired. Kind of lethargic too...” I shook my head and sharply slapped my cheeks a few
times trying to shake away the sleepiness as well. “It’s fine...it—I’ll get used to it.” I waved it off and forced a smile.

“ You shouldn’t push yourself, Madam.”

I jumped as the speakers down the hallway rang with Kazuha’s voice.


“I could say the same for you, Kazu!...I think this definitely would be covered with any sick time? Medical leave of absence? Maybe a
vacation? ”

“As lovely as that sounds, Madam. Working is taking my mind off wanting to eat people .”
I frowned as we kept walking towards the containment room. Swiping the card I stepped into the observation room and blinked. Kazuha
had replaced a great many things that belonged to Yuto with his own. His desk, piled high with paperwork. His bed was made neatly in a
corner. His wardrobe was folded across the bed, getting ready to put it away in the dresser. One wall was filled with TV screens with
different parts of the manor on it.

“Madam.” Kazuha was on the other side of the glass, staring through the glass. I knew he couldn’t see me due to the tint. It was just a little
eerie .
“Kazu—do you know how this happened?”

“The thing that was thrown at us was an old sample. I am unsure how that man got his hands on it. My best guess is that there’s more
than just him that had an issue with the changes we were making. Someone more senior must have given it to him. I’m having some
people look into it.”

“Old sample?”

“Yes...concentrated RC cells that take a mist form when agitated. Which—I suppose being thrown would count as being agitated . Our

last of such samples. Your father got it from the CCG years ago. A sort of origin to ghouls; though the notes on it seemed purposefully
vague. There were apparently many attempts at making a cure with that specimen. That was something your father was hoping for. To
cure his brother. To reverse the build up of RC cells and possibly to make a cure to Ghouls. Make them human. The attempts gave rise to
the suppressants we know of today—but never the cure he hoped for. The sample was largely abandoned for many years.”

“What about the man who threw it...or the security?”

“They were all tested. They all have higher than normal RC levels, but seeing as they weren’t in the area when the vial broke, it seemed to
have not caused any transformation. They will be tested for a few months to keep an eye on them. The man who threw the vial will be
charged with assault. Though the details of the attack were kept...vague. Without mention of the sample causing—” he paused and then
gestured at himself.“This...”

And of course. There was the matter of—

“...Merlin?”

Kazuha’s eyes turned away from the glass and he looked forlorn. “ He was the luckier of the two of us. He gets to have that vacation you
mentioned...meanwhile I must continue to work. You were right, Madam. I shall look more into it, but there is a severe need to go
through the lab staff more closely and weed out the ones who would work against what you want to happen. I shall see if I can hire
someone to investigate from inside...”

“Thank you Kazu...I’m so sorry this happened...You know...when I said you could get a mask, I hadn’t meant for you to turn into a
Ghoul so you’d have a use for it...”

The man behind the glass rolled his eyes. “I assure you, I still don’t require one...”

“Well that’s too bad.” I smiled faintly as Kazu glanced at the window and narrowed his eyes. “Uta’s going to come in there and measure
you so he can make you a mask.”

“That is unnecessary—”

“Too bad.”

“Aika—”

“Nope. Not hearing it. You're getting a mask. When you come out of there. You are going to be safe. And you're going to have a mask—I
’m not losing anybody again! ”

I hadn’t realized I raised my voice as I spoke but the ghoul on the other side of the glass stared through it. “...Madam. I am begging you
that nobody comes in... please don’t come in...”  I glanced up at Kazu who was inches away from the glass but impossibly far away and
out of reach. “...I need more time. You can pick out a mask that’s already made—if I come out I’ll have him make me one...but please
don’t open the door. I don’t trust myself not to end up hurting someone...”


“Okay...” I didn’t like the way he said if he came out. He couldn’t stay in the box forever. “Anything you need I’ll make sure you get it
Kazu. When you come out, you visit the shop and you get a mask that’s fitted. In the meantime, I’ll find one that suits you at the
shop...I’ll give it to you the next time I come here.”

Kazuha nodded his head, folding his hands behind his back. “As you wish Madam...How do you feel?”

“Me?...Terrible. I tried to eat...but there’s nothing that tastes edible. It’s almost making me rethink being human. Funny right? I’m
probably just going to put healthy things into a blender and make smoothies and drink them as fast as possible so I don’t starve...” I

chuckled humorlessly.

“But...I guess it’s better than the alternative..?” I winced a bit when it sounded like a question. “We have to find a cure now...for Merlin....”

“I anticipate that such a goal would require some things that you expressed your distaste for. Testing on subjects...for example.” Kazuha
began pacing in front of the window, hands behind his back as he spoke. “I will focus on personnel first...as you know. None of your
goals will happen in a few months. You should be prepared for it to take years.”

I knew that.
Nodding my head I glanced at Uta. Maybe there were some words of wisdom that Uta could impart upon Kazu? Uta’s eyes weren’t on me
though, they were staring at the other ghoul beyond the glass. He said nothing though; simply observing the new ghoul.

## ♥


Uta’s eyes watched Ai-chan’s right hand carefully as the other ghoul paced on the other side of the glass. Seeing a ghoul in confinement
would normally raise some uncomfortable feelings for most Ghouls; yet this ex-human was in a self-imposed confinement out of fear—


Of himself. What he could do to the other staff members. Or to Aika.

He had the self control to get down here, have the boy removed and isolate himself. It was impressive for someone unused to what must
have been an assault on his senses. But now that he was down here the man was visibly anxious and on edge. His begging for them not to
enter the room was concerning for Aika’s future; should she ever turn Ghoul.

When she decided to.

While his concern that she would change involuntarily at any moment was mostly gone, it was now replaced that in her current state she
would be sick, weak and unable to eat.

“How often does she need to take the pills?”

Kazuha looked up from his pacing. “Every 24 hours would be recommended. 48 would be pushing the limits if she ever gets in a sticky
situation. Anywhere from 52 to 72 hours would be a total failure of the medicine. If she were to take another double dose it might save
her—but only if her level’s haven't already risen too high. If she crests the 970’s then—There would no longer be another option for
her...I’d recommend getting an updated RC cell count from Chickafuji.”

“What’s your level, have you checked?”  Aika spoke up, looking earnestly concerned through the glass. Uta watched her hands press
against the glass and frowned. For as much as she claimed to be irritated with the man for keeping her captive as a child, it seemed that
she’d come to care for the staff. Even for Kazuha. Over the month spent here, he saw that they were more than employees to her.

“Mine rose to 1100 and have been steady there...Merlin started to develop the ROS tumor hours before I turned.  Likely because he ran
through the substance while I was further back. You were behind me. We got him to care but I neglected to have myself checked until it
was too late. I hadn’t realized until—” The man paused and he swallowed.

“—Until I... Well the cravings are—- difficult to ignore . Chickafuji was the one to point out my eyes had changed. From there I made
sure that I was isolated. Madam, don’t worry about me. I shall continue to run things just as efficiently from down here as from
above...perhaps without distractions I might actually work better...”

Uta watched Ai-chan’s mouth curl into a sad smile; her eyes moist with unshed tears. “I see. I’m a distraction, am I?”

Kazuha’s eyes stared at the window and then he turned away to walk back to his desk. “Yes...at the moment you are. You’ve got other
things to attend to, don’t you? If you need anything. You know where to find me.”


## ♥







## Chapter 79: Yuto’s Vacation
Chapt er   Text
## Chapter 79: Yuto’s Vacation

I knelt down on the ground, staring at the gravestone erected with forget-me-nots planted around it. Etched into the stone was the name
Bjorn. A paw print impressed into the stone above his name brought tears to my eyes even as I tried to choke them down.

Wiping furiously at my face I sniffled and stood up. “Alright...Renji should be here any minute. Yuto !!!” I called for the boy and saw
him running out from around a bush with a huge happy grin on his face. “Ms. Ai!!!”

He was so happy to be outside after being locked up for so long. I leaned over him and ruffled his hair again even though he was trying to
squirm away. “Hey— did Uta clip your hair again?”

“Yeah!” The boy ruffled his hands over the shaved side with a wide grin.

“Alright Perfect. It looks good kiddo...let's get you to my uncles.” I didn’t like having the kid out in the open but it was just a few
moments while I stopped at the grave of a friend. Yuto stopped and looked at the grave with a frown.

“Who’s...Bjorn?”

I glanced at the grave with a sad expression and sighed. Yuto would have loved Bjorn, and Bjorn would have adored the boy. It was too bad
they never got to meet and play; they both would have dug up holes in the garden together.

“He’s...he was my best friend. My dog. He was killed recently...”

“By ghouls?” I scoffed and shook my head.
“Yuto...you should know. Not every problem in the world is Ghouls. It was actually an investigator that killed him...”


“But...Investigators are the good guys? That’s what my mother and father said...” The boy stared at the ground with furrowed brows and
a grimace on his face.

“Yuto...You know that they’d kill Uta and myself if they ever caught us, right?”

“Why? That’s stupid ...you're good. You saved me ...”

“They say it’s a crime for me to love him. It’s a crime for him to even be alive...” I watched the gears turn in his young head and he glanced
in Uta's direction. Looking at the ghoul myself, I tried to see what he was thinking beyond his usual passive face.

“...I like Uta though...and Kazu...” He was getting it slowly. But he was getting it.
“I know kiddo...I have some really cool ghoul friends. Maybe one day you can meet them all, okay? None of them would hurt you. I
promise. You get to meet Renji today—he’s driving us out to the countryside.”

“He’s a ghoul....?” I nodded to his question and the boy seemed to think more.
“So it’s a secret that they are ghouls? I don’t want you or Uta to get hurt...”

“Yeah kiddo...it’s a secret. Everybody here already knows. But outside they don’t...”

Yuto nodded his head and looked up at me with a sad frown. “...I’m sorry about your dog...”

“Me too...come on. Let’s go wait for Renji at the gate.”

I walked with the kid at my side, picking up my gibson case and went to stand in front of the gate. Coming up the way I could see Renji’s
beater car and smiled. Yuto leaned against the gate and watched it come up.
“Alright—come on. You got all your things?” The boy nodded, hefting two large bags with him. One full of things to do and another
with clothing. Uta stepped up and grabbed the heavier of the two and put it over his shoulder.
“I’ve got it.”

I pushed a button to open the gate and made sure that Yuto stayed close as we went to the car. Renji got out and stood by the door,
watching Uta, Yuto and myself walk down the path. “Hey kid.”

Yuto stepped closer to me and gave Renji a wary stare. “Hey, he’s quiet but I swear he’s good, Yuto. He’s got a niece that’s just finished
her upper-secondary schooling. She’s started university! Isn’t that neat?”

“Can I go back to school again?” I took a sharp breath in and smiled painfully.
“Sure kid...but we’ll have to figure that out. You might have to have some schooling here rather than in the school you used to go to.”

“Oh...Okay...” I leaned down a bit and prodded him gently with an index finger.
“Hey, what’s that sour look for? You're going on vacation for a while! We’ll deal with school when you get back! And I’ll make sure you
get the best education you can possibly get!”

“...I miss my friends...”

Oh. “...I know. Of course you would...but remember how I said that Uta and Kazu and everyone being ghouls was a secret? It
means...that you also are a secret.” I took Yuto’s stuff from him and put it in the back, piling my guitar in too. “---if you went back to
school again like before; investigators would show up at school and take you away. They’d ask you how you're alive. What happened?

And they’d ask who was taking care of you...do you understand?”

The boy sat himself down in the back of the car, scooting across to the otherside. “Yeah...”
I sat myself down in the back and closed the door while Uta got into the front with Renji. “Ms. Ai? Can I get piercings like Uta?”

“I—” I was caught off guard by the question. I wasn’t his parent, but I was acting a bit like it. Should I say yes? Or no? My parents never
would have let me—but then again maybe he was too young? I glanced at Uta who turned his head just enough to look at me—
“That’s—I don’t— ask Uta !”

I panicked.
The ghoul’s eyes went a little wider, staring at me and then the boy as Yuto leaned up between the seats. “Uta! Can I get piercings like
you?”



“Yes...?” The ghoul looked at me again, his answer was a question. But he looked just as unsure as I did. Uta panicked.

“ No. You’re too young, kid. Ask again after your birthday...” Renji spoke up from the front seat, sighing and looking between me and
Uta. “ You two are hopeless...”

“Okay, yeah—Listen to uncle Renji!~ ” I joked softly. “Ask again in a year.”

“ Awwwww... But I wanted an earring...” The kid pouted and I laughed softly. In the mirror I caught Renji staring back at me with a
surprised look on his face.
“ Uncle Renji?” The silver haired ghoul went back to staring out the front. “How do you figure...?”

“Awwr, Renji—what do you mean?” I reached over the seat and patted a hand on his shoulder. “Don’t cha’ know you’re like a big brother
to me!~” The car was tense for a few moments and I couldn’t tell why. Had I said something wrong? Renji slowed the car down and
turned his head to look at me.
“... big brother? ”

“You're older, yeah? Sorry...I didn’t...mean to assume...It’s just how I felt. My real family mostly sucked but you're like... ’found family’
to me? It’s fine if you don’t feel the same. I just care about you...” My smile faded a bit and I leaned back in my seat, hand slipping from
his shoulder. He caught it, larger hand covering mine and gripping tight.

“...I was just surprised... Aika-chan ...” Renji let go of my hand, putting it back on the steering wheel and I smiled faintly.

“...Would that make Itori an aunt...?” Uta asked and I burst out laughing.
She would be that one ‘‘‘wine’ aunt’’ stereotype who was the life of the party! Wouldn’t she?

## ♥


Yuto glanced between us and sat back in his seat, smiling faintly as he watched the adults laugh in the car. Ghouls and humans. It was
hard to imagine any of them eating someone like that one little ghoul had when she came for his parents.

He glanced at Uta and wondered how closely he knew that ghoul. How could they know each other if they were so different?

## ♥


As we pulled into the wooded area that led to Hiroshi’s cabin in the woods Uta reached for me, holding his hand out. I looked at him

funny and then stuck my hand under his and he dropped a red pill into my palms. Oh.

“You should take your meds, Ai-chan...”

“Yeah...I think you keep time better than me...Do you have any water left? I ran out on the way—thank you.” He smiled faintly before I
was even done talking and grabbed his own water bottle and handed it back to me.

I dropped the pill into my mouth and washed it down with a gulp of water. Even still, it left a bad taste in my mouth where it started to
melt.
“Alright, now we’re ready. Come on kiddo!”
The kid jumped out first, turning around in a circle to look at the area surrounded by trees and nature.

“Whoa!!!”

I chuckled softly and grabbed my guitar case. Uta glanced at the case and reached for it, pausing as his hand got close. Hesitantly I handed
it over; not sure why he seemed so unsure. “Thanks...it’s a little heavy.” And I was very tired.

As I expected, as we walked the path I began to feel tired and lagged behind the young child who ran ahead. More than that, I was
struggling to keep up with the two ghouls who followed the child.
“Uta...” I said softly, drawing his attention. He looked back and frowned. His footsteps stopping were closely followed by Renji’s.

Renji turned back and came to get me. I knew Uta would have, but he had his arms full of Yuto’s bag along with my guitar. “I’ve got
her...come on imouto...climb on.”

Little sister. I smiled faintly as Renji knelt down and let me climb onto his back. I wrapped my arms around his shoulders and legs were
held in his hands to keep me up.

“...that medicine you're taking is doing this?”

“Mmmm. Yeah. I’m sorry...”

We continued forward with me now carried forward. Uta glanced our way briefly before looking forward again. “She’s not going to be
strong enough for training.”

“Yeah...we’ll have to stop. She’s too fragile like this...”
I frowned and huffed softly. I didn’t want to stop my training. Yet even I could see and admit that it wouldn’t be possible now. I couldn’t
even walk a few miles down a forest path without becoming tired and out of breath. I couldn’t get through the day without feeling sleepy .
If I moved too fast or tried to exert myself in a fight I felt like I’d end up throwing up on the spot.

Not to mention I probably wasn’t eating everything I should to maintain the muscle mass I’d accumulated. Just today I’d managed to
suck down a mixture of salads, bacon and vitamins. It had been blended up into a slurry that tasted like rotting cabbage. I’d choked it
down though and drank a too-hot cup of coffee to flush it down.

I’d try to keep doing pushups, sit ups, anything I could to try and keep some of my muscle; but there was only so much I could do if I
couldn’t eat properly. An all liquid diet wasn’t good for someone either.


“...Maybe my body is just adjusting...it might get better. We can ask my uncle how my father was when he was on the medicine.”

“That might be true.” Renji said, sharing a look with Uta.

“It might not be.” I scowled at Uta for his generally pessimistic thinking before he continued speaking to Renji.
“Her RC cell levels reached 921 before they stopped.” Uta said, repeating what Chikafuji said the night before. He had also echoed
Kazuha’s warning that if it went over 970 there would be no stopping it or reversing it.

“That would explain why the symptoms seem similar...” Renji sighed and turned his head, talking to me. “---Your body is reacting a bit
like a ghoul’s when it’s hit by RC Cell repressing gas. It makes us tired and weaker. Vulnerable to being cut by regular scalpels.  It’s how
the CCG often catches us. It explains why you're so lethargic...but that means it’s probably going to be sticking around long as you take
them. How long did you have to take them for?”

“...If she stops she’ll become a Ghoul.” Uta supplied calmly. “She’ll be taking them for some time.”


I nibbled on my bottom lip and frowned into his shoulder; sulking. It was my choice to stay human—wasn’t it? Then again the choice was
forced upon me; I would have rathered it would never be a choice at all. Being human used to be the easy choice...now it was going to be a
lot harder to stay this way...

“Hey!!! I see a cabin!” Yuto shouted ahead of us and I raised my head, breaking out of my sulking mood for a moment.
“Slow down Yuto... ”

Far ahead I saw the cabin too. Smelled the campfire. And saw the older man sitting on the log by some cooking meat. He stood up and
stretched as we approached and Yuto stopped running ahead. As we got closer he decided it was better to duck back and stay close to Uta.

“Uncle! I told ya’ I’d be around soon. I brought the kid. I’m really thankful you said you wouldn’t mind watching him.”

“ Mind? ” The man chuckled loudly. “Are you kidding? I love this—A little kid to teach to hunt and fish and fight? It’ll be like having
you here all over again!”

“Fight?” Yuto said with wide eyes. I squeezed Renji’s shoulder and he let me down. I went straight to Yuto right away and glanced at
Hiroshi with a small smile.
“Only if he wants to learn to fight...” I glanced down at Yuto who looked uncertain . “He taught me to fight with a wooden sword. Some
fencing as well...He can teach you too if you’d like. But anything you don’t wanna do, you don’t have to. Okay?”


“Of course he doesn't. Sorry kid—I got a little over excited there. I’m Hiroshi. I’m Aika’s uncle. It’s nice to meet you. Glowbug told me a
lot about you.”

Yuto glanced at me nervously and I chuckled. “Oh come on kiddo. He doesn't bite.” Oop, wrong set of words . Albeit true.
He The child stared at me and whined. “That’s not funny!”

“It’s a little funny...?” I laughed and reached a hand out. “Come on. He really won’t hurt you. I promise.” Yuto reached out and took my
hand. I took a step forward but paused when Yuto wasn’t coming with me yet. When I looked to see what the hold up was I saw he was
looking at Uta— a hand outstretched.


The ghoul was looking at it like he wasn’t sure if he should take the hand. However after a few heartbeats Uta reached out and took the
kids' other hand. Hand in hand I walked him over to Hiroshi and smiled.
“Uncle....this is Yuto. He’s a little timid right now. But he’s a ball of energy when he gets settled in. I hope you can handle it at your age!~”
I smirked and stuck my tongue out at the older man when he gasped in mock offense.

“We’ll get along just fine. Won’t we kiddo? You want some fish? I caught some and had it cooking for you when you arrived.” He
pointed at the fish being cooked over the fire. Hiroshi raised his eyes to me once more and his smile fell a bit.

“I’d offer you some as well...but it seems like you probably won’t want any, right?”

I grimaced and shook my head, the scent from the meat was foul.
“I thought not. I’d recognise that smell anywhere. If I recall correctly, meat in particular is repugnant for you.” Hiroshi sighed and
nodded towards the fire and the seats around it. “Alright, well at least take a seat...I know you're just dropping him off. But you can all
stay the night again. Head back in the morning. Might help the kid settle in.”

“You could just admit that you miss me!~” I giggled and took a seat, letting go of Yuto’s hand and patting the log for him to take a seat.
Yuto sat and Uta sat on the other side of him. “Wait–what do you mean smell?”

“Hummm? The scent that’s practically oozing from you. It’s from the medicine you're taking. Your father smelled just like that. I’d
remember it anywhere.” Hiroshi wrinkled his nose unpleasantly. “...I suppose that accident at the labs you mentioned over the phone was
bad enough you're gonna be stuck on those for life now, huh?”

“Oh....yeah. It seems like it. I had some questions if you don’t mind uncle...”

“Sure Glowbug.” He checked the other meat over the fire and then picked it up, taking a bite out of it when he deemed it ‘done’. “What’s
on your mind?”

“Do you remember what Father ate? Or how he was when he was on the medicine...I feel sick. And tired. Drowsy. All the time...”

“Yeah. That’s pretty much how your father was too.” Hiroshi took another bite of his meal and then licked his lips. “He used to drink
down black coffee like there was no tomorrow. Probably the only reason he got any work done.”

That wasn’t the news that I’d wanted to hear. I’d wanted to hear that it was going to get better. Not that it was going to stay the same.
Forever? LIke this?



“Hmmm...that letter you sent before. You mentioned you were getting married? And you want to have it out here...?” Hiroshi changed
the subject.

“Yeah, that was what I was hoping for. So you’d come...? Or I suppose everybody would come out here...you’d be able to meet some of
my friends...?”

“Yeah...I gathered that’s why you wanted it that way. You think that’s a good idea though?”


“Everyone is Ghouls. And everyone who would come is friends with me.” I glanced at Renji and smiled: “Or like family...nobody is going
to rat you out.”

Hiroshi crossed his arms and made a ‘hummmmm’ sound as he thought it over. Briefly he glanced at Renji and then Uta—and lastly
Yuto. “Speaking of family...you're looking like one here...but you're going to adopt him out to someone else?”

“That’s...the plan. But right now he’s on vacation. Safe and far from the city.”

“Of course, of course...He’ll be safe here. I’ll make sure of it...”
Hiroshi picked out a fish from the fire and held it out to the boy.
“Here you are, boy. Take it. It’s for you.”  Yuto was slow to take it, staring at it like it might bite him. He glanced at Hiroshi and then the
crispy fish. Even I could hear his stomach growling as he stared at it.

“Go on kiddo, I might be a ghoul but I remember how to cook. I was human once before—had to keep Glowbug fed while she was here
too.”

## ♥


Hiroshi spent the whole time mostly asking Yuto questions; what he liked and what he wanted to do while he was out here. Getting to
know the kid and making him feel comfortable. Something that he was far better at doing then Uta had been. Which is to say—it was
going much more smoothly.

I stood up and reached for Uta, pulling him away from the fire and back out into the slowly gathering night. On the way I grabbed a
blanket and glanced over my shoulder at my uncle who was smiling at Yuto with open affection.

“How are you feeling, Ai-chan...?”

“Tired...like my arms and legs weigh a thousand pounds. I didn’t even do much today. Renji even carried me out here.” I sighed and
threw the blanket out onto the field grass and collapsed onto it. Uta followed, lying down beside me. “I just didn’t expect it to feel this
bad...”

I rolled over, snuggling close to Uta’s side and throwing a leg over him. He shifted a bit so he could wrap an arm under and around me,
holding me to him. “...not going to try to convince me to go ghoul?” I said softly, nuzzling my head into the crook of his neck.

“No. It sounds like you might prefer it though. Until you want otherwise; you're my fragile little human.” I smiled faintly squeaking
when he moved away and up, leaning over me to kiss my lips, cheeks, chin and neck. He quickly glanced in the direction of the campfire
and smirked a bit. Hiroshi wasn’t paying any attention with the small boy keeping him occupied.

“I told you...I’ll protect you. So you can stay human. You don’t have to worry about not being able to do training.”

“Mmmm.” I moaned softly and laid back my head to give him more of my neck to press kisses into and nip. “Is what my uncle said true?
Do I smell ?”

The ghoul chuckled as he pressed himself closer, his warm body comforting in the chilly evening air. “Only a little bit...It just means I’ll
have to cover it with my own scent, doesn't it Ai-chan?”

“ Please... ” I whispered as he placed his mouth against my throat and kissed.

“ I can still HEAR you two.”


Uta looked up again; a small scowl adorning his face. “Hummm...not far enough away...” I giggled and reached for Uta, pulling the ghoul
back down into a kiss. Breaking for a moment I said:  “You could always steal me away into the forest...”

“He’d probably come after me if I did that.” Uta leaned back into the kiss, stealing another and nipping at my bottom lip. The ghoul
broke the kiss and pulled away. He licked his lips and growled.

“What’s wrong...Uta?”

“Nothing Ai...everything is fine.”

“Uta...please...Tell me.” He hesitated to answer, but eventually did as I gazed up at him with a small pout.

“I can taste the suppressants in your saliva. They sort of tingle...” He licked his lips again and frowned. I reached up and cupped my hands
around his face and stared at him with concern.
“Uta...is that going to affect you? Hurt or weaken you like the synthetic organs...?”

Please say no. Please...losing food was one thing, but not being able to kiss him? Not to have the same intimacy as before? That might
break me completely. What was the point if I couldn’t enjoy anything anymore?

“I’ll be careful Ai...” He leaned down and nipped my shoulder, kissing up my throat again. “No biting anymore though...” He gently
pressed his teeth back in that spot of my shoulder. “I’m satisfied with this mark...”

“Satisfied? You make it sound like it’s an impulse to bite me. To make a mark. Is it?”

The ghoul hummed softly, nuzzling the spot affectionately. “Yes...”

“You were biting me quite a bit from the start!~” I teased softly, putting my fingers through his hair as he stayed close. The ghoul’s lips
curled into a smirk against my skin.
“Yes...Your mine Ai-chan...”

“...and you're mine. Even if I don’t...understand in quite the same way.”

“...it’s not so dissimilar to the meat.” Uta said, trying to explain but confusing me further.

## What?

“What? I’m like meat...you realize that’s not comforting, right?” I asked, echoing the question in my head.

“The meat...when you didn’t want me to take it from you.” He stayed still now, content to just hold and be close. “In the food store...you
reacted like I was going to steal your meal. It was concerning at the time. But it’s like that...I don’t want other people touching you.”

“Renji picked me up earlier...” I noted and the ghoul growled softly. “I know...his scent is on you.”

“That bothers you even though it’s just Renji?”

The ghoul hesitated and then slightly shook his head. “Not so much anymore...you called him your ‘found family’....?”

“Yeah...people you choose to be your family...I never had siblings but I love him like a big brother I never had...”

“Some of the staff too...” Uta mentioned softly, lifting his head to gaze down at me. “Merlin...Kazuha...”


“Merlin’s like a rough and tumble uncle, when Hiroshi went away...he was there. And Kazuha? I hated him before...but not really. I
really just hated my parents for giving the orders to keep me locked up...not really him . He is...an annoying older brother. Mr. Perfect.
Calm and collected. I have to bother him and push his buttons...be a bratty little sister to him. See if I can get him to crack a little bit.”

I gently tugged on Uta, pulling on him until he settled on laying on me. I would never be able to lift him but the weight was comforting.
And he was keeping me warm. “I’m so worried about him. I know he’s scared he’s going to hurt someone but he can’t stay in that room
forever...”

“You said it was a good idea. Would you trap yourself in a room...?”

“Me...? Maybe for just a little bit. We’re running out of rooms though...I would be so worried about hurting you. I...I wouldn’t even
know what I might have to adjust for. The sort of senses I’d have to get accustomed to.”

“You couldn’t hurt me, Ai-chan.”

“You don’t know that. Maybe I would...” The ghoul chuckled softly, amused but not speaking unkindly.
“I think I can restrain a newly turned ghoul with no experience. You’d be fine, Ai-chan...trust me.”


“I do Uta.” I trusted him so much.

I smiled and took in a deep breath of cool country air. It was nice to get out here once in a while. Get a breath of fresh air. See the stars. “We
could sleep out here...if you want. Or we can go back to the hammocks...?”

The ghoul groaned softly from his spot but said nothing else— “Good enough for me...you keep using me like a pillow if you're
comfortable.” My hands pulled his hair tie out and put it on my wrist; then my fingers returned to his hair. Buried into the soft black
locks as I began to doze off...

## ♥


Uta raised his head and watched his mate’s slowly rising and falling chest as she slept. She had fallen asleep quickly. As comfortable as he
felt using her as a pillow in the field he expected her uncle would come looking any minute. Her back would also not be very forgiving.
Slowly he sat up, wrapping the blanket around her and gently picking her up. She groaned and wiggled a little but she stayed
unconscious.

Returning to the campfire with her in his arms the others looked over and their voices dropped low. Yuto was by the fire, drifting off all
on his own as he stared into the flames. He, like Aika, would be off to sleep very shortly.

“Put her to bed young man, then come here and talk for a bit...” Uta stared at the older ghoul and then nodded. When Aika was in the
large hammock Uta made sure she was rolled up nicely in her blanket to keep her warm and tucked a few strands of hair away from her
eyes. For a few moments her eyelids fluttered and she murmured nonsense but then she quieted again and relaxed into slumber.

At the fire, Uta sat and looked over at the older ghoul. He wasn’t sure what to expect. Perhaps another warning to never hurt Aika like
last time.

“You got her the medicine in time...Glowbug called me on the phone I’ve got here. She said you ran with her like a possessed mad-man
through the streets to make sure she got back in time. Her words, not mine. I was wrong about you...I figured you’d be the type of ghoul
that would rather have her be just like you. You could have gone a bit slower, taken your time and arrived too late for it to help...” Hiroshi
stood up, grabbed a meat stick from the fire and walked beside Uta.


Shoving the stick into Uta’s hands, Hiroshi clapped a hand on the younger ghoul’s back.
“You're a good kid...have some food. You too.” He gestured at the fire and the remaining meat for the silver haired ghoul.

“...now...about that kid...” Hiroshi glanced at the now sleeping child and hummed softly. “Are you two planning on keeping him...it’s a
strange situation to get a kid from since she literally bought him. But he does look like you...so you could very easily pass him off as your
own, if you felt so inclined.”

“Aika says she’s going to try and find a good home for him...” Uta glanced at the kid and frowned. “But she’s attached. I think if he’s sent
far away she’ll worry about him too much. But she’s also concerned with how dangerous our lives are. There’s no place for a child until
she achieves her goals and the world is safer...”

“That sounds like the Glowbug I know...What about you?”

Him? Uta wasn’t sure exactly what Hiroshi was asking. “What about me...?”

“Do you want to keep the child, are you attached?”

Uta glanced at the sleeping child. He hadn’t ever considered having kids. Hadn’t ever thought he’d have someone to want to have kids with.
Then there was Aika. His human mate which complicated any child they might produce. She hadn’t exactly changed his view on having
children; she shared many of the same thoughts. The world was too dangerous—it was too messed up to have a child in it.

But he turned and watched the child; his chest rising and falling slowly as he slumbered while laying over the log. The boy was slowly
slipping from the top of it; likely minutes from falling off completely. Someone should go pick him up and put him to bed, but Uta
wasn’t sure that should be him...except that maybe Aika would want him to. The child seemed to like him...despite everything. He was
the impulse to promise he’d be kept safe because Aika would want him to; wouldn’t she?
On the other hand; It was even nice when the child seemed to be trying to emulate him. His hair being cut in a similar way. Asking about
piercings. Before long the kid might ask about tattoos. Those feelings weren’t because of anything Aika said or did.

He was fairly sure that the answer for tattoos should be ‘no’ for now. He wasn’t the best judge for that sort of thing. Aika said he deserved a
normal childhood—but what was normal?

“I’m not sure...I never thought about having kids...” Uta kept watching the child then finally when nobody else seemed to be doing it, he
stood up and righted the child by gripping his shirt and shifting him back up onto the top of the log before he fell onto his face in his
sleep.

As funny as that might be to watch the kid eat dirt—Uta could imagine the scowl that Ai-chan would give him.

“What about the ghoul that killed his family? Glowbug tells me you both know them...”

Uta kept his face blank, shrugging his shoulders. “What about her...?”

“Are you going to do anything about them?”

“...what would I do?” Uta said calmly.

“Don’t play dumb with me boy. I know you must feel something. Aika told me about the auction; everything... that was clearly an attack
against your mate, albeit not a direct one. I ain't a new Ghoul, I know that has to have had an effect on you...”

“The Ghoul who did it is SSS rated...”


Hiroshi looked surprised and then frowned deeply. Years as an investigator told him exactly what a SSS rating meant. Whoever the person
was, was an extremely powerful Ghoul. “Are you able to keep Aika safe?”

“...yes. I am. I’ll keep that Ghoul away from them.” Uta sniffed at the meat that he’d been handed and finally took a bite out of it.
“...but I’m still recovering...” Although he was brief about it, Uta explained that he’d eaten fake meat at Aika’s behest and the resulting
weakness.

The weakness that clung to him despite eating plenty of other meat. It was helping, but much slower than he might have hoped for.
“Well...I can’t tell you how long that weakness will last. If your body used the energy and nutrients from that meat to build cells, it
depends on how long those cells remain in your body...blood cells can live 120 days. Which means that replacing the cells with healthy
ones might take a little while. The best thing to do is just keep eating healthy...”

“—Glowbug loves you. She’s marrying you. So you're my nephew...so if you ever need help, I'll do my best.”  The older ghoul grinned
though, adding: “Don’t get me wrong; you ever hurt her, my warning from before still stands...in the meantime...I’ll watch the kid. Until
you decide if you're keeping him or not. You’d better not wait too long to decide though....the kid deserves people who care about him.”

## ♥







## Chapter 80: Surprise!!!
## Notes:
(See the end of the chapter for  notes.)

## Chapter 80: Surprise!!!

Leaving behind Yuto felt strange, but the kid seemed happy and well rested. When we left him with Hiroshi he had been chasing a

grasshopper and trying to catch it in his hands. Uncle was shocked when I handed him the Gibson case. It was the second one I’d bought. I
still had the one back at Uta’s apartment. Honestly, I’d only bought the second one when I was feeling low and unsure about—-
everything.

It felt good to give it away. I didn’t need the second one, because I wasn’t going anywhere. I was staying with Uta.

“You think he’ll be okay?"
I couldn't help but glance back over my shoulder. We were far enough away that I couldn't see the cabin anymore and each step Uta took
carried us further away.

"He'll be alright, Ai-chan. Your uncle seems happy to watch over him."

"I know..." I leaned my head back down on his shoulder and sighed. "He'll be safer outside the city for a little while...and uncle will watch
out for him. I think he’s always wanted a kid, honestly. I know if anybody did come out here looking for the kid he'd protect him."

“...Do you want to keep him, Ai-chan...?”

This again? “Uta...we talked about this before.”

“You care about him. Do you love him?”

“I feel responsible for him. I’m responsible for making the best out of all this. Trying to fix something I know can’t be fixed. No matter
how close I get to the world I want to make, it’s never going to make it okay. It’s not going to bring back his family and caring about his
well being isn’t the same as loving him like a parent. I feel it’s my fault. I should have told you no. I should never have played along and
gone with you. Then none of this would have happened to him. He might not understand that yet. He thought he was going to die and
he might see me as some savior that took him from the auction.  But we’ll always be the ones responsible for his family being taken away
from him. Plus, I can’t handle having a kid—especially not now.” With a sigh I added: “If things didn’t keep going wrong around every
corner. If you weren’t still a Clown. If Roma wasn’t alive . If I wasn’t one pill away from becoming a Ghoul...perhaps.”

“You want Roma dead...?”

“You’ll have to forgive me for that Uta...there’s only two people I want dead ; and she’s made the list...”

“It’s okay...”

I leaned my head against Uta’s neck and smiled: “I’ll admit though...seeing you try so hard is quite adorable...but we can’t be his family...”
Even if part of me wished we could. Even if I had grown attached. Even if I adored seeing the child trying to emulate Uta. Uta could be a
great dad, with some work.

But it couldn’t work out, even if I wanted the child to stay.

It was dangerous and how could he ever be expected to forgive us?


## ♥


I hated how easily I’d fall asleep, but I found myself stirring awake when Uta was placing me in the car. I reached for him, lightly gripped
onto his shirt and murmured an apology.

I’m sorry that I’m so tired. So weak. Too scared to become a Ghoul. Too scared that I might lose myself. That it would change me too much.

He sat down beside me in the back rather than climbing in the front seat.  I leaned my head onto his shoulder and smiled faintly. “I love
you...” I murmured softly and I began to drift again.

If I rested on the way home then maybe I’d be able to stay awake later. I could force myself to be helpful at the shop if I drank enough coffee.

## ♥


## Two Weeks Later

Staying human and taking medicine became a game of regulating how tired, weak, or ill I felt at one time. I did my best to hide most of it
from Uta.

When I was just feeling nauseous I’d take Dramamine and power through the day without eating much, instead scarfing down food at
the end of the day or before he woke up.

When I was tired I’d power down cups of coffee until I couldn’t stand to drink anymore.

When I felt weak I’d sit down and do something sitting down; like helping with needlework. It didn’t take a lot of muscle.

When I couldn’t do much else, I’d sit in front of my paperwork and go through it. Looking at everything that Kazuha sent me. I kept tabs
on him. He called more often now. A little over two weeks into being a ghoul and I think he was getting lonely in that room by himself.

I asked how he felt often.

He told me he felt fine. Though he did note that the organs tasted, in his own words: ‘Bad, Madam.’

That however, did not stop him from continuing to eat them. From what he told me he seemed to be having a similar approach to food as
me; eating it as quickly as possible without tasting it too much. Luckily, he did not seem to be experiencing the rejection that Renji had
when he’d tried the organ meat.


Today was a bad day in terms of how I was feeling so I was leaning over some paperwork when the phone rang. I checked it and saw
Kazuha’s name on it. I picked it up and sighed: “Hey Kazu...I’m looking over the personnel files right now. All these people have
connections to the CCG from the looks of it...is there any way to remove them? Without causing a stir...? I don’t want a repeat of what
just happened.”


“A repeat event would be unlikely since we don’t have any more of that particular sample. However I understand what you mean,
Madam. If you send the files back, I shall put them aside and begin the efforts to slowly change out the staff.”

“Some of them are nearly at retirement age...” I flipped through some of the pages with a thoughtful gaze. “---is letting them take an early
retirement with pay an option?” If I was more careful and gave them options and a good deal nobody was bought to be angry.

“It could be. I will look into it. We might also be able to determine if many of them have anti-ghoul ideologies by asking if any of them
want to work on a cure again. Efforts for a cure stopped after your father died. They could be started up again. It would be a good step
towards possibly finding something to help those affected by ROS.”

“Yeah...you can do that. I’ll send over the files...maybe tomorrow.” I yawned and leaned over onto my side with the phone held to my ear.

“Madam...?”

“...Sorry...I’m just tired.”

There was a moment of quiet on the line and the ghoul on the other end let out a soft sigh. “Have you been taking vitamins with your
food as well? If you're not eating as well, it’s especially important.”

“Yeah...of course. I’ve lost a few pounds of weight though anyway. Nothing too terrible...I know I should have Chikafuji look at me again
for a health checkup. But I’m too tired to go to the manor...maybe tomorrow.”

“Madam—”

“Don’t you scold me...you still haven't let him in to check your own health. So when you do that perhaps we can worry about me. I’m still
human Kazu...that’s what’s important to me right now. I’ve been keeping track. It’s only five pounds. The last couple days I was able to
keep down more food. Anyway...Uta got a large order in and he’s going to be busy, so I’m trying to help him with everything that I can.”

“Very well Madam. Please keep an eye on your health...”

“You too...” I clicked end on the call and let out a long breath. I could stay here, close my eyes and fall asleep. Or...I could force myself up
and go do something. What I’d said about Uta’s shop was true. Someone had made a large order and the ghoul was working diligently to
try to get it done in time for the customer. It was getting closer to the end of October again.

Which meant Halloween. It would have been nice if they’d decided to order a bit sooner so Uta didn’t have to do it all at once. Crawling
off the couch I managed to stumble my way down the stairway and sit on my usual spot; watching Uta as he stitched, glued and re-
measured fabric for the masks.

The ghoul glanced up only briefly before going back to work. “You want to help stitch...? That one is almost done.”

“Yeah...I can do that.”

“Ai-chan...do you want to go out tonight after I close the shop?” That woke me up a little bit. Going out and doing something might be
good for me, even if it tired me out.

“Sure. Sounds fun as long as you don’t mind if I get too tired and you have to carry my sorry ass home!” I chuckled softly and got a small
smile out of Uta. “Itori’s been wanting to see you again...also—” He put down his tools for a moment and hesitated before continuing.

“...There’s another event on Halloween. I’m going...”


Event. So an Auction once again. It had been months since the last one...so it was bound to happen again. I had asked him to go to less
which meant that he was still going to be going to some of them. Fighting to keep my face placid I nodded. “Alright. When is it?”

“Halloween.”

“Shoot...and I was hoping you’d go on a date with me—” Uta’s frown deepened and I waved a hand. “Forget it, just promise you’ll be
able to go out with me again on Christmas Eve, and I’ll be happy?”

“Deal...You’ll have me for ‘Kinro Kansha no Hi’ as well.”

“AH! A two for one! You drive a hard bargain Uta-kun!!” I smiled wide; the only thing I could do in a situation like this.
“You better make sure you’re free on your birthday as well, and I’ll call it a deal!” I rolled closer, holding my hand out and wiggling my
eyebrows.

Uta smiled faintly and reached out, shaking my outstretched hand.
“What about yours?”

“Mine?”

“Your birthday. It’s in October. But you never said when.” I smiled half-heatedly and waved it off. I hadn’t expected that he’d
remembered it.
“It’s not important.”
The ghoul stared at me for a very long minute before glancing back down at his work.

“...It’s Halloween, isn’t it?”

“Noooo...” I drew out the word and glanced away, deciding that the masks were much more comfortable to make eye contact with. “It’s
the day before Halloween. But we’ll be busy finishing this order so you’ll be free on Halloween. So it’s no big deal. Let me help and
maybe we can get it done sooner and then I’ll let you bring me somewhere? What can I start on first, those straps?”


Uta frowned and then looked over the desk, scraps of masks everywhere. Uta set aside some leather that was cut into strips. “Yeah...Can
you do that?”


“On it!”

## ♥


That night my fingers hurt after sewing and stabbing myself a few times. The tips of my fingers were adorned with quite a few band-aids.
Uta had worked a bit later than usual, closing up the shop and then continuing to work until he finally gave up for the night. Uta placed
his mask over his face and I wore mine and he took off, running his way across the city from roof to roof.

I missed running with him. I even missed falling and being caught.
I’d even train with Uta again over this weakness.

By the time we got to the bar I was in a fairly solemn mood, once more thinking of all the things I’d lost. Still, I didn’t feel like I should
complain. After all, Uta might understand that I wanted to be human but how much could he sympathize? At what point was it not

worth it? At what point should I give up? So I kept my complaints to myself.

“Here we are...” Uta put me down on the ground and pushed the door open. I stepped in and jumped a foot into the air as confetti
popper sprayed me with multi-colored paper.
“Holy—” I cut off my swear while staring at the culprit.

“Happy Birthday!” Itori and Nico cheered! I stared, looking at the two of them with wide, startled eyes. Beside me Uta shuffled in to
stand next to me.

“...I didn’t know when it was. So I told them it was in October. Itori wanted to have you over.”

“Well U-kun, when is it?”

“The day before Halloween.”

“Oh well. So it’s about a week early! She looks surprised anyway!!! Come on!” Itori slapped the counter a few times.
“You can drink whatever you’d like, Aika-chan!” I smiled and laughed aloud at her enthusiasm. The energy was infectious and exactly
what I needed right now!

“You know you might regret that when I start asking for shots! Everything tastes terrible now, so if I wanna get drunk I might as well!~”

“You can have as much as you want, I swear!” She grinned and leaned over the counter. “My Birthday present to you! Plus I heard that
you’ve been feeling terrible. So you might as well get super drunk! Hangovers can’t be worse, right?”

That’s true! How much worse could it get?

Nico was sitting at the bar as well. He turned around on a stool and gave me a small smile.
“I got you something as well.” He nudged a wrapped box towards me and smiled. “Go on, It’s nothing fancy or anything, dear. But I
thought you could use something to brighten your day!”

Carefully I pulled away the paper and opened the box. Inside were a few cute shirts, ones that he’d picked out for me. They were all
tastefully colorful. “Nico—they're great! You knew I still need to add color to my wardrobe!!! You're not stalking what clothing I wear,
are you!?~ Thank you so much!”

“I’m glad you like them dear!~”

“Alright! Bottoms up!” Itori slid a few shots in front of me and I downed them without a question. They went straight to my empty
stomach and made the world go blurry around the edges within a handful or two of minutes. Straight alcohol tasted about as bad as
before and worked just the same; perhaps a bit stronger on me.

## ♥

I clung to Uta as I continued to drink. At some point I had crawled up into his lap and nuzzled close to his neck. Inhibitions gone.
“You smell nice...” I don’t know what I’m saying; just that it’s true. Uta smelled really really good...

“So Ai-chan how do you feel? Uta said you’ve been sick...”

“Fuckin’ terrible.”  With no filter I couldn’t stop the complaints I’d been holding back flow out of me. I held up my thumb and

forefinger, putting an itty bitty space between them. “I want food to taste like food again...it all tastes rotten, bitter or burnt. I hate it so
much...”



Uta took a sip of his drink and as it passed near me I got a whiff of the scent off it. It made my stomach cramp up immediately. It smelled
good. I kinda wanted it...

Sobered by the horrible realization that swept through my body, I tucked my nose up against Uta’s throat . “Are you okay, Ai-chan...?”

“Yeah...” I said softly, holding onto him.

It made some sense. If the numbers said I was close to being a Ghoul, perhaps things that he ate or drank would smell good despite the
suppressants. That didn’t make me a Ghoul —and I wasn’t going to admit that my drink-addled mind considered for half a moment to
grab it from Uta’s hands and down it to see if it also tasted as good as it smelled...

## ♥


Uta carried Aika back towards home, holding her warm body to him. Her much too warm cheek pressed against his neck letting him
know that she was still drunk. She had sobered a bit before downing more drinks and passing out completely in his lap. After that he
excused himself from his friends in favor of getting Aika home safe.

Itori had sent him home with some liquor for Aika and a bottle of blood wine for him.
“You can have some drinks at home and get comfy on the couch when she’s not feeling good. Maybe not this drunk again though. Just enough
to take the edge off everything...” Itori had given Ai-chan’s unconscious form a sympathetic look.

“She’s not handling the medicine very well, is she...?”

“This is the first time in a while she’s complained of anything...” Uta had replied.

She was keeping all of it to herself now. Giving him soft smiles to reassure him even as she suffered through the worst of it. He knew of
course what it was like to try and eat human food as a Ghoul, however he did not know what it was like to have to eat it to survive when
there was no other option.

He admired her for her commitment. He would be the first to admit that he was hedonistic. The pleasure of food was one pretty high up
on his list. If suddenly he couldn't enjoy a meal, he wasn’t certain what other more destructive pleasures he might indulge in.

As it was, she had dove into drinking with abandon.

After the next auction he’d plan a date. Somewhere he could bring her out and they could enjoy a whole night alone. No food—but enough to
do that it might distract her for a while.

## Notes:
A/N: Very little polish or editing. Trying to move along. I'll go back and edit in a bit for errors.





## Chapter 81: All Hallows Eve;
## 

## Notes:
