Chapt er   Text
## Chapter 81: All Hallows Eve;
## 


Uta finished buttoning up his dress shirt and pulled on the zebra striped suit over top of it. On the way out the bedroom he made sure to
grab his gloves, a precaution to hide all his tattoos. In the living room he glanced at his mate, lounging on the couch. She looked up from
some paperwork. Her eyes lingered on the zebra suit before rising to his face and smiling faintly.

“Be safe.”

Be safe, not: ‘Have fun.’

He understood though that her distaste for his activities were too much to bear. She could not conscionably wish him a good time. Uta
moved beside the couch, crouching down and leaning closer to her. She leaned forward to meet him in the middle and pressed her soft
warm lips against his. “I will.”

“I’ll say hi to the others for you.”

“Not Roma. You can tell her to go to hell from me...” Uta saw her smile ruefully before adding: “I suppose that wouldn’t be the best thing
to say to her. Even if I’d really like to. I can settle for her getting no hello from me.” She reached up and grasped his face quickly and
pressed another quick peck against his lips. “Alright, now go on and hurry back once you're done.”

“Renji said if you need him you can call.”

“I’ll be fine. I’m not going anywhere without you. I promise. As far as anybody needs to know, nobody is home!” Uta stood up, watched
her for a few more moments and then nodded.
“Good...if there’s an emergency—”

“There won’t be. Go. Before your friends think you ditched. I don’t want the miniature-psycho to come here looking for you...” His lips
twitched a little, fighting back a smile at the names Aika made up for Roma.

Miniature Psycho was a new one.

Uta walked to the door, grabbed his mask and slid on his shoes.

“Don’t forget your medicine, Ai-chan.”

“I took it a few minutes ago. Thank you Uta-kun!~”
## Good .

Uta turned finally and left without looking back. Through the shop and out the front door, locking up behind himself. He masked
himself and took off to meet his friends.

## ♥


“ Ahhhhgh! I liked having a big fancy carrrrrr! Where's Wendy?! Didn't she have fun last time?" The small ghoul spun in a circle
playfully. On her face Uta spotted the huge malicious grin hanging on her face just below her mask. “She’s going to miss the show
tonight!”

"---And what did she do with the kid? Did she feed him to you?Oh I bet he was tasty !!!!" Uta watched Roma from behind his mask, the
covering allowed him to glare at the ghoul as she cheered and ‘played’.

Perhaps he did care about the child, because the idea of eating him turned his stomach and made him want to snap at Roma for making the
comment.

He was feeling defensive of the child. Even if he wasn’t his.

“You didn’t though, did you No-Face? She’s kind of a wet-blanket. OH ! Is she keeping him somewhere!? Maybe I could have a bite!?
Pretty please!?”

Uta finally felt something give and he turned towards the small woman and growled . “I think you’ve eaten enough of his family.”

The small ghoul stopped gleefully hopping about and turned to fix him with a thousand yard stare.
“Oh...? Does No-Face care about the kid now? That human’s rubbing off on you and making you weak. You're going soft!” The ghoul
turned her head, and marched off leaving Uta standing with Itori and Nico. Beside them another ghoul joined them; his classical clown
mask watching the spectacle: Souta .

“ Drama, Drama! ~ And here I thought we were all friends!” The man called Souta shrugged and followed Roma. Uta followed soon
after with Nico and Itori close on his heels.

“...Are you feeling alright, No-Face? It’s not like you to snap at her...”

“I am feeling fine.” Uta reached out, catching Itori’s arm. The red head looked back and waited: “Check the inventory...I don’t want any
surprises like last time.”

“She’s not here this time though...” Itori sounded uncertain and Uta frowned. Why was he asking this? He’d never had a problem with
announcing anything before.
“It would be nice to know ahead of time. That’s all.”

## ♥
I watched Uta leave the house and then waited an hour. Then two. I was sure he wasn’t coming back for some time. Maybe not even
tonight.


Ever since that night at the bar I wondered something. It was horrible. Disgusting. But it ate away at my mind. Carefully I stood up and
made my way to the fridge. I knelt down and opened the fridge, looking in over the many many many Tupperwares full of meat. Human
meat.

Trying not to think about it too hard before reaching for one and picking it up. With my eyes squeezed tight I cracked the lid and
inhaled.

My stomach clenched and my mouth immediately watered. It smelled so good. The best thing since starting the pill. If I didn’t know what it
was I might have wanted it.

I slammed the lid to the box shut and clamped my jaw shut tight. No. No. No. Please...
I’m not a Ghoul! So why does it smell so good...!?

Putting the box of meat away I stood up, going back to the couch where I could shakily grab my phone and pull up Chikafuji’s number. I
waited a minute...and then put the cell phone back down. It was Halloween. There was no way he’d get here in a reasonable time. Calling
him would be admitting I had a problem.

I stood up, went to the cupboard and took out an RC cell test. With the lancet in one hand I jabbed my other quickly; wincing from the
prick and then squeezing my finger over the tube until I had enough blood for the test.

Putting the test aside. I waited.

## ♥


Uta stood on the stage, announcing each new ‘product’ as Roma or one of the others dragged another frightened human onto the stage.
It was fun...

But there was a nagging feeling at the back of his mind that something was bothering him. Perhaps it was the way Roma grinned at him,
egging him on by shoving a young woman near him and gleefully and loudly announcing how good her fear smelled on her!

It felt like she was doing it on purpose. Picking a human a similar age to Aika. A similar build.

“Please, please! Don’t do this! I’m begging you!”
The same words that every other human begged from them.

Uta gleefully announced the women's final Price and stood as she was dragged back off the stage. As she passed him she reached out,
grasping his arm and crying. “Please!? Please! How can you do this!? I’m a person!!!!”

Uta glanced down at the human, pulled his arm out of her grasp and stayed silent. How could he do this? It sounded like something Aika
would say and he hated that the woman had managed to remind him of her when he’d been trying so hard to ignore any similarity.


As she was dragged away she was crying , screaming a last insult before she was off stage: “ Inhuman monster!!!” The similarity was gone
and Uta stared forward over the crowd.

“Awwwwr! Wasn’t she cute!? Buyer number 369 is really lucky to grab her!~ She seems like she’ll be real fun! ” Roma jubilantly danced
her way around the edge of the stage and giggled as the crowd laughed.

“And that concludes our auction for the night! Everyone who bought can collect your merchandise in the collection area. Please head to
reception to make your payments!” Uta bowed again and then exited stage left.

He was followed shortly after by the others. Souta and Nico broke off to go help with the merchandise and Roma followed Uta.

“See! Wasn’t that fun No-face! Just like old times!” Roma jumped and climbed onto his shoulders. “You know, you could still ditch the
human! It’s not really working out is it? I mean after the last auction, she can’t be very happy with you is she? Everything going downhill
once she found out you're really a monster like the rest of us!? I don’t smell her on you today. Has she even fucked you since—”

## ♥

The combination of antihistamine, caffeine and calcium carbonate helped regulate my stomach, headaches and nausea. Laying down on
my side I closed my eyes deciding to take just a short nap...

I snapped awake to the sound of the door opening and panicked. The room was dim and I was still half asleep when the shadow of

The ghoul turned and blinked, looking at the time on the TV box. “...11pm Ai-chan. Were you sleeping?”

“Just taking a nap. You scared me...I didn’t think you were going to be home this soon.”

The ghoul kicked off his shoes and pulled his mask off. He tossed it onto the table, scrambling some of my paperwork.

“Hey—” I was cut off as he cut across the room quickly and leaned down to kiss me roughly. Stealing the complaint from my lips.
“What’s—” Another kiss. “---gotten into you?” He pulled off his gloves and threw them away, cupping my face with one and grasping
some hair with the other.

“I love you.” I obeyed, leaning into the kisses though not as hungrily as him for now. He was worrying me. “Uta—are you okay?”

“Fine Ai-chan...Please—” The ghoul leaned over me, kneeling one knee beside me and hovering over me.
“I know you don’t feel good—I can make you feel better.” My face flushed pink and I was so surprised I couldn’t argue with him as he
picked me up off the couch.

“Wait—Uta. Did something happen...? You shouldn’t be home yet...?”

## Chapter 82: Date Night

When Uta woke up in the very early morning hours the first thing he did was crawl out of bed and strip the suit off himself. The second
thing he did was check Aika over for the marks he knew he’d left on her. His hands were gentle on her as he moved aside covers to take a
look at the damage. Her hips were a colorful collection of hues and her thighs also were marred by water color of bruises.

Maybe he shouldn’t have gone so rough...
His frustration had worked its way out, but at what cost? He had (at least briefly) upset her with the comment about the suit. About him
being a monster.

That was how she saw him when he wore it; wasn’t it? His ‘costume’ he used to go sell humans as though they were worth nothing ?

Still, he couldn’t completely regret what he’d done. She said she felt better . Sleepy, but good sleepy. Even now as she slept she looked
happy with a little smile on her face. It was better by far than the pained or frightened whimpers in her sleep.

He’d make it up to her. Bring her out on more ‘date nights’ again. They hadn’t gone on a real one for some time. They could have some
'normal' fun. Things that she liked and would be what couples usually did. Movies. Walks in the park at night. He could carry her up
another building to get a good view of the top again—Perhaps that last one wasn’t quite normal but it was fun.


Hum, wait...had she said something about using a cock ring on him next time? The thought brought a faint flush to his cheeks. Had she
been joking in the moment or...?

## ♥

## November 30th


I found that I liked the wintry air. It kept me awake and alert. It felt crisp and fresh when I poked my head out the door earlier so the night
was likely going to be a bit on the colder side. We might even get our first frost!

I dressed accordingly for the date ahead. I looked in the mirror and smiled faintly. The woman in the mirror had lost a little bit of weight
though most of it had been muscle. Thankfully the efforts to eat despite the disgusting "food" had made it so I hadn't lost too much
weight.

Not being able to work out though softened the muscle I'd built up.

"Uta-kun...where are we going?" I stepped out of the bathroom and frowned at the ghoul. He was dressed in casual but nice jeans and a
long sleeve black button up rolled up to his forearms. Each of us wore our matching bracelets.

"It's a surprise."

"Well I need to know how to dress? Is this okay?" I turned in front of him, showing him the white flowing blouse with flowers speckled
across it (courtesy of Nico)  and flared grey pants.

"You might want a coat."

"Yes...I figured. Since it’s cold out. Are we going to be inside or outside mostly though?”

“Both.” Well that helped me guess not at all.

“You didn’t plan any food on the date did you? I don’t think we could survive us both grimacing through dinner...” I sat myself down on
the couch and sprawled out. It had been a month since I’d quietly discovered that human meat smelled like food to me now and I had yet
to mention it to Uta. I tested often despite taking my medicine religiously—thanks to Uta.

The ghoul opened the cupboard and grabbed the pill bottle as I thought of it, walking towards me and looming over me. “Ai-
chan...Open up.”

I grinned a little and opened my mouth quickly and closed it before he could drop a pill in. He chuckled and leaned down, grasping my
jaw and pried it carefully open. “Don’t be difficult. We’ll be late.”

I gently bit down and held onto the knuckle as he put the pill and his fingers beyond my lips. Closing my mouth around his digits I
swallowed the pill. The ghoul growled softly feeling the suction on his fingers and pulled them free with a pop. “Trying to eat me now,
## Ai-chan!?~”

“I would never. I don’t know what you're talking about! If I were I’d bite down a bit harder, right?~”


The ghoul smiled faintly and reached down to haul me up off the couch. “Come on Ai-chan...we’re actually going to be late if you don’t
hurry. I’ll carry you...”

“Wait, wait! My coat!” I whined softly, gently smacking his back as he hauled me up and away. He grabbed my red and black coat off the
hanger by the door.
“This one will be fine...”

“That’s a heavy jacket...but I suppose it’s been kinda cold anyway. So we’ll be outside?”

The ghoul didn’t reply and I silently cursed my luck. He was really good at keeping secret plans! I should have expected he would be.
“You ask one more time and I’m blindfolding you until we get there.”

“No fair! Wait-wait!!! I’ll be good! I’ll be good!~” Uta smirked as he put me down on my feet by the shop door. I reached for my jacket
but he pulled back, instead sweeping it around me and helping me slide my arms in. Such a gentleman today!~

“Can you tell me if we’re walking or if I should get us a ride somewhere?”

“I borrowed Renji’s car.” Uta said with a small smirk. I raised my brow and snickered.
“Borrowed? Did you steal it again...?”

“He knows I took it.” I laughed aloud and reached for his arm.
“He’s going to get sick of your antics one day you know.”

“He still tolerates me.” The ghoul was still smirking a bit as he opened the door. I ducked under his arm and walked out into the chilly air.
The sun was setting soon and the temperature was dropping. Uta locked up the shop and pocketed the keys before holding out his hand.
“Come on we’re—”

“Going to be late! We wouldn’t be if—” Never mind, Uta was giving me a look like he was going to pull a blindfold out any second.
“Alright, then let's hurry!!!”

## ♥

“Ai-chan...we’re here.” The ghoul had had me close my eyes and cover them with my hands before we got to where he was taking me. I
peeked between my fingers and looked around. We were in the parking lot of a very familiar theater!

“The movies!!! Wait–why do I need my coat then?”

“I’ve got somewhere else after this to take you...plus, It’s always cold in theaters. Come on. Renji’s going to pick up the car here.” The
ghoul hid the keys to the car under the passenger seat and stepped out of the car.
“Got your sunglasses, Uta?”

“Yeah.” Uta popped them on from a pocket and waited for me to join his side before walking towards the theater. We went to the
concession counter and while I wished I could still enjoy popcorn it smelled burnt and like it was covered in curdled milk. Not a good
combination. This new sense of smell and taste helped me appreciate one thing though: How terrible everything smelled to ghouls. How
much Uta had been putting up with when I made my food.


“Can we get two waters, please?” The teen at the counter glanced at me with a bored expression.
“Yeah sure hold on. Is that all you want? Just the water?”

“Yeah...” She gave me a ‘ seriously ?’ look before I added: “On a diet...trying to avoid winter weight this year.”

“Okay...here’s your two waters. That’s 840 yen.” Yikes. That seemed like a lot for water? Not that it mattered for me but it seemed
ridiculous. I handed the money over with a smile and then the second bottle to Uta.
“Which movie did you pick?”

“Three Thousand Years of Longing. That okay?” He pulled two tickets from his pocket and showed them to me. Oh . That one had
looked interesting when I’d seen the trailers! It seemed like a romance but also with a healthy dose of mythology and fantastic elements.

“Perfect! I wanted to see that!”

“I know Ai.” I glanced at him and blushed faintly as I remembered how closely Uta would watch sometimes. He might seem aloof but he
watched the world and people around him with wide curious eyes. Taking in everything. Myself included; a human living in his (or
OUR ) home. I am often the target of his curiosity and his watching.

“Of course you do! Come on—you said for yourself we were going to be late!” I grasped his hand and pulled him towards the theater;
ignoring the way my body protested moving quickly.
Walking through the dark of the theater there were a few other couples seated already. My steps fell unevenly on the slanted floor and my
ankle gave out, twisting and making me yelp in surprise before Uta caught me and pulled me back to my feet.

“Careful.”

“Sorry, didn’t see where I was stepping. And I’m fragile...” His arm remained around my waist as he walked us to our seats, letting me slip
into the row first and he sat on the outside of the aisle seat.
“I don’t mind.”

I leaned close to the ghoul, resting my head on his shoulder. “I think you like me being a fragile human.”

He turned his head slightly, lips falling into a faint frown. He spoke quietly as well so as to not disturb the others in the room, and so our
words wouldn’t be overheard.
“...not this fragile...but yes. ” He had stuck by me as I clung to humanity. Even though it was hurting me. Even though it was
inconvenient. Lately I haven't gone anywhere without the ghoul. He could protect me from danger, or myself. Keeping me from falling
over my own feet in a movie theater for instance.


I smiled faintly at the reassurance. The screen lit up  as the room plunged even darker and the film started.

## ♥



When we exited the movie theater our ‘borrowed’ car was still in the lot, but we passed it in favor of walking to wherever Uta wanted to
bring me next. We walked slowly, making sure I never lost my breath and taking in the early decorations for Christmas that had already
gone up.

It’s been about a year. The thought occurred to me suddenly and I paused, staring at the lights strung from trees. “Ai-chan...something
wrong?”

“No, I was just thinking it’s only been about a year since I walked into your shop...a bit over it actually.” Everything had happened so
nonstop that it felt like so much longer. Christmas Eve would be our ‘one year anniversary’ of dating, wouldn’t it? Unless we counted the
other dates...

“—And your birthday is coming up again. This year we’re going to do something on your birthday, Uta!” I continued walking with him
and looking around. In the distance I heard chattering gather louder and bells . I glanced at Uta and then hurried a little to glance around
the corner to spot the edges of a festival happening at a Shinto shrine.

“I thought you might like to go. If you get cold I’ll carry you home...”

Excited, I reached for him and tugged gently so we walked a bit faster. “It’s not so cold right now, and I love festivals! Come on!”

The festival was a bit less wonderful then the last time we had gone to one, mostly on account of it smelling like human food . I hurried us
from one spectacle to the next, hoping we could get it all in before my body decided to fail me and tire out. I pulled us past the food
vendors and to the ones that sold trinkets; getting a few things for my friends once more. Maybe I could give Touka something again.
Remembering the friends from Anteiku and the trinkets I’d grabbed them before made me sad .

“Hey, let's go to the shrine, okay?”

All the while the ghoul followed obediently, watching me with a small smile on his lips.
I stopped at the temizuya and picked up a ladle filled with water and followed the ritual. I had to walk myself through it slowly;
remembering it as I went along.

Wash your left hand, change the ladle to the left hand, and wash your right.

Take the ladle again with your right hand and
pour a bit of water in the left palm and rinse your mouth.

What was next? I hesitated for a second and then rinsed my left hand again.

Slowly raise the ladle to an upright position to let the water rinse over the handle.
And put the ladle back. Uta followed the steps I had just done and I waited patiently for him so we could both walk up to the shrine
together.

I pulled out some coins and held them in my hand as I waited in the line of people going to the shrine to pray. They were warm in my
palm by the time we got to the front of the line. I tossed in the money to the offering box. Bow twice. Clap twice.

Please let my friends stay safe. I pray that everything is calm and that those whom I love are safe and happy.

I bowed again deeply and turned to Uta, seeing him with his head bowed and his face thoughtful. We turned once he was done and
bowed once more, departing from the shrine quietly as others followed in behind. I wondered what sort of things he prayed for.


“One last thing...” Uta said softly, leaning down by my ear.
“We can go see a bird's eye view of the shrine if you’d like...?” He glanced up a tall local building and smiled at me. My body was starting
to feel cold and hurt but I couldn’t deny that seeing everything with all the lights and the people would be fantastic . A perfect way to end
the date...

“Sure...But I didn’t bring my mask.” He pulled us into an alley street that was empty and from his pocket produced his ‘no-face’ mask.  I
‘hummed’ softly and shook my head.

“Mine doesn't fit in my pocket like that. I should really have you make me one that can fold up like that...”

“I can show you how to make your own basic mask like this. If you’d like, Ms. Kamenashi? ”
I felt like my heart swelled when he said that and I stared up at him with a happy grin.
“Of course I’d love it if you'd teach me!”

Before he could slide the mask on I grabbed his jaw and pulled him closer; leaning up to press my lips against his. “I love you... thank you .
Tonight was really fun.” Uta grinned and backed me up into a wall and leaned down to hungrily devour another kiss.
“Careful someone might—” I was cut off by another hungry kiss and moaned softly into it as he teased me with his teeth nipping at my
bottom lip. He was careful not to break the skin and get any blood in his mouth; since it was like a poison to him now.

“---someone might see.” I said breathlessly as he finally broke away.

“Let them.”

I flushed and giggled softly before softly placing a chaste kiss on his cheek. “Come on...let’s go or I’ll want to keep kissing you in alleyways
forever!~”

“No complaints here...”

My smile faded to confusion as a small can-like item was thrown into the narrow alleyway. It landed by our feet and burst into a fine
vapor that burned my eyes and my lungs. I felt arms wrap around me and pull me up off the ground, running.

When we burst out of the cloud I found myself in Uta’s arms. Looking up I could see Uta’s serious expression, devoid of any mask. It
took me too long to realize that we were just attacked and we were now fleeing. “Your mask...?”

But we had been attacked without any masks on. So whoever had just thrown that thing had known .

The ghoul didn’t answer, concentrating on moving quickly. He leapt and used his Kagune to climb up between the buildings. About
twenty feet in the air he grunted, winced and the blood red kagune that held us up evaporated as if melting away and we fell.

## Chapter 83:  Old Foes



We fell. Falling down Uta held me so he struck the ground first, grunting in pain as he landed.

“Uta—hey...get up!? What happened?”
I crawled out of Uta’s arms and started trying to tug him up to his feet. He came up slowly and his face was set in a grim expression.
Something was terribly wrong if his Kagune wasn’t working and he was making a face like that.


“Run Ai....Run away as fast as you can.”

“What— no !” I spotted something sticking out of his shoulder and reached for it. I gripped it by the glass tube I pulled it. Needle pulled
out and I held in my hand some sort of syringe device that had plunged something into the ghoul.  Glancing up at his expression I could
see he was looking at it with contempt. He looked nearly enraged ; an expression I don’t think I’d ever truly seen on his face until now.
Before now that sort of look had been hidden behind masks and his Kakuja.

“What is this...?”

“ That was a Quinque steel needle. With a sedative and more RC Cell repressants. It took me some time to find you two after last time.”


I spun, turning my head to stare at the man who stepped out from an alley street and felt bile and venomous hate boil up from my
stomach.

It was the same investigator that had killed Bjorn.

“—But not many people have a dog that large in Tokyo. Finding one of the very few owners of a Great Pyrenees wasn’t as hard as I
thought it might be. Afterall, dogs need to be registered or you get into quite a lot of trouble. And from everything I found on you, you
liked avoiding trouble. Up until about a year ago...” He pulled some notebook from a pocket and flipped through it.

“You brought that dog to every annual checkup. Heartworm. Tick prevention. You even brought him once when he was limping.
Turned out he just stubbed his foot. Isn’t that right? Hummm...you had him registered as ‘Bjorn’. I suppose this explains why you called
him ‘Bear’ before. I had to question a few others who owned similar animals. But many of them weren’t in the right age range or the right
gender. Then I found you. No dog anywhere near you now, is there? Aika Kaneshiro and you... Uta. No last name on record...nothing
on record actually.”

The man continued, fearlessly walking closer with an almost casual tone as he kept speaking. “A mask maker. A very convenient job for a
Ghoul, isn’t it? I’m impressed. How did you ever get away with having a shop like that for so long?"

“I was most surprised at you however...” He continued, turning his gaze back on me as I clung to Uta, helping him stand as he started to
slump and weaken.
”...such a big name for such a young lady. You could run back to your manor now if you'd like. If you run, I won’t chase you. But... I
will take him apart piece by piece. It’s not really what I’d like to test... but I suppose I could use a new Quinque...”

“ Run Ai-chan ...” I heard Uta say it again close to my ear regardless of the man's warning.

“ I can’t...” Even if I could leave him here alone at the mercy of the investigator, I physically couldn’t run. I wouldn’t get far plus there
was no guarantee he was telling the truth about not going after me. What if I lead him to another friend? Another part of my makeshift
family?


"I won't kill him if you stay put. I just want to observe a few things before I hand you both over. Ask a few questions. With everything I
have on you, catching you both alive and the research I can get from you I’ll be able to get a Special Class investigator Rank. I’ve worked
ten years to try to achieve it, but nothing has worked. Surely something as unusual as you two will cause a stir at headquarters..."

The man watched me as I clutched to Uta’s side. The ghoul slumping closer and closer to the ground as Uta lost strength. Finally he
grunted and he fell to his knees.

“How fascinating...even when you know it’s hopeless, you still stay with him?  It will only be a few minutes...you may struggle all you
like, Uta. I imagine it’s taking everything in you to just stay awake. I put enough sedatives in that to knock out someone almost three
times your size.” The man smiled as he said the ghouls name, apparently reveling in the fact that he’d found out what it was.

“A concentrated dose of repressants like you’ve just got, along with a sedative...you will be knocked out cold for hours.”


I didn’t know what to do. What could I do? It’s my fault! It was me that got Uta caught. It was Bjorn who had accidentally led this
investigator back to us.
“I’m sorry Uta...I’m so sorry...I—” The ghoul’s hand tightened on my arm and I saw his eyes soften a bit as he looked at me.

It’s okay. He seemed to be saying. I watched in horror as the black and red receded from his eyes and showed soft grayish-purple eyes that
must be his ‘natural’ color. “Uta!”

A moment later his human looking eyes closed and his body slumped to the ground. Unconscious and dead weight in my arms, bringing
us both down to the ground.

“ Uta, wake up! ” I shook him by a shoulder and glanced up as the investigator approached, unbothered that I was still awake. I wasn’t a
threat to him. I never had been.

“Are you coming quietly?”

As quickly as I could I grabbed both of our phones. I pressed and held number one on the keyboard. It rang a few times and I heard it
pick up. I practically shouted into the phone as I hastily spoke; the only means of help I could try and give us.

"Call the Raven. Tell him we were caught.”

Then I threw them as hard as I could. They smashed into a wall and broke before falling into a water grate and disappeared. I gripped
onto Uta and grit my teeth together and glared at the investigator;  but didn’t move away.

The man looked shocked for a split second before he smiled and nodded. “....Interesting. A last ditch attempt at a rescue? Should I be
expecting more friends? You could still leave. He would never know that you left him if you fled now.”

“Go to hell...”

“Ah I see. Settle down now—” He reached for me and I slapped away his hand only to have it gripped and a needle pressed into the
muscle. No, no, no, no, no!!!!

“There we go...don’t fight it dear. It’ll be better if you just relax—”

My body wasn’t able to fight off sedation. I slumped over Uta’s body and as I laid there fading from consciousness I gripped as hard as I
could to him. A last ditch effort to not be separated .

## ♥

When Uta awoke he noted immediately the restraints that were on him. Cold metal bands on his wrists, upper arms, ankles and a collar
around his neck. They latched him down to a table that held him up at a 75 degree angle. His shirt was missing and his shoes were gone.
The room he was in was a sort of observation room.


He could see that Aika was in a connected room, separated by a glass wall and a single sliding glass door. There was a red light above the
door indicating that it was locked. Above both rooms there was a large clear glass window where he could see the investigator watching
them both like rats in a lab. Uta could see her though, latched down to a table and still asleep. Breathing at least.

Unlike him, she had been stripped not only of her coat but also most of her clothing. Down to her underwear. A fact that grated on his
nerves. He touched her and stripped her of her clothing?

He growled when he noted the man's eyes on her, not yet noticing that he was awake. The investigator glanced at him and smiled with
false pleasantry.

“Oh, good. You awoke! How are you feeling? Hungry?” When the investigator was met with silence and a glare he sighed and made a
note in his notebook.
“Please...tell me when you last ate. It’s important I know this sort of thing.” He turned his head towards Aika’s room again.

“I will give you a warning: when you refuse to do something I ask, I am afraid that I will have to hurt her.” Uta saw him reach for
something.

“Wait...I ate this morning.” The man's fingers hovered and then pulled away from what Uta assumed was some sort of button. The
investigator picked up a pencil and noted down something.
“Good...very good. Okay. How much did you eat? Please be specific.”

“...A liver. And the meat stripped off the ribs...and a few eyes.”  Uta answered, staring upwards. The investigator didn’t flinch, but he did
continue to write. Nodding subtlety to himself.
“A decent meal...you must prefer to eat daily rather than gorging down your meals? I suppose that means you might get hungry
shortly....that could pose a problem. I don’t have anything for you to eat. That is a bridge we’ll come to in a bit. I am sure I can figure
something out for you to eat.”

Uta didn’t reply to the man's comments, his eyes lingering on Aika who began to stir.

## ♥


“Ah, there she’s awakening now...how nicely timed.”

I opened my eyes and quickly slammed them back closed. The room was almost blinding white, its floor and walls like white hospital tile.
“Uta—?” My mouth worked but my voice cracked dryly.

“Let's just give her a minute...here. Perhaps she’d like to see you.” The ‘bed’ that I lay on was hard and began to lift and turn so that I

alive, currently our situation was...

Terrible didn’t even begin to describe it. Catastrophic perhaps.

I was fairly certain there was a decent chance that we both might die in captivity.
“Where are we? Is this Cochlea?”


“Hum? No. This is my personal research and containment room. I had some adjustments added for the two of you. But after I’m done
with you, he’ll be going to Cochlea. You on the other hand will be going to Corniculum. That’s where we keep the humans who are

like?”

“Go to hell...” I spat again. My body was hungry for food since I hadn’t eaten on our date and when we were taken it was time for me to

“Very well...I will give you one chance a day to eat. If you refuse I’ll ask you the next day. There will be consequences to refusing my

“Wait—!” I heard Uta raise his voice as an electric current shocked my body, my vision went white for a few moments and a scream

“You said you wouldn’t hurt her—!”

“I just wanted to show you what would happen if you don’t do exactly what I ask...That was the lowest setting. It was meant for a Ghoul
so I don’t think I should raise it any higher. So Uta. I’d like to take a look at your Kakuhou. More specifically I’d like to remove yours—”

“NO! Don’t fucking touch him!” I screamed from my restraints fighting them and tugging and rattling the whole table. “Don’t lay a

“So noisy—” The investigator hit another button and I could no longer hear the other rooms or what they were talking about. I could

I kept screaming as the investigator flooded the other room with RC Cell suppressant gasses to weaken Uta again. Then he entered the

see that the ghoul on the table was yelling, likely screaming in pain as the red sack-like organ was pulled from his back. Uta was left with a
bloody red gaping hole where his Rinkaku would have been. Cut down to the spine.

When the sound from the other room was turned back on I listened to Uta’s harsh breathing.

“U...Uta!?” I shook my restraints and felt fear and dread threaten to overwhelm me completely. I didn’t know if that would kill him. Did
I get Uta killed?!

“Uta please! Say something...” I whimpered softly.

“I—...” The ghoul swallowed and winced as he tried to speak. “I’m okay...Ai...it...will...regenerate...”

“He is correct of course. His Kakuhou will regenerate. I suppose this will speed up your hunger though. I am curious...has she seen you

The monster's voice was cold and clinical as always as he scribbled more on his notebook. Holding his grizzly prize in his hand like a

## ♥

The investigator kept Uta’s back facing me, forcing me to watch as his flesh slowly and painstakingly regenerated and put itself back

together. I began timing how long the investigator was gone from the window. Counting 60 seconds at a time. Minute by minute. And

Just to check on us. He was silent most times...watching. Observing. Occasionally he asked a question of Uta.

I wasn’t sure what to say to Uta in between times with the investigator’s eyes on us. There weren’t words that would help . I wanted to cry

Maybe I could have gotten us away? Maybe we wouldn’t have been out at all tonight to begin with.

Perhaps it was last night now. How long were we unconscious? How long has it been since I took my medicine? I swallowed as a new terror

“Uta...my medicine...” The ghoul lifted his head, turning it so he could look at me with a worried expression.

“Well look at you two.” My words died in my throat and I glared back up at the investigator who had returned. “You are looking much

“Not yet. Rest assured, they are all still safe. As for your company, it will be because of me that it will get handed over to the CCG as an

“No.” I lied through my teeth.

“...Ah. I see...Aika. I think you’re lying. Some of them must know . Don’t they? Do I need to show you what happens if you lie?”

“No—Wait!!!”

The investigator ignored my cry for him to stop and hit a different button. The ghoul across from me made a pained noise as the clamp
around one of his arms began to twist mechanically. Slowly.

“Stop! STOP! STOP! I won't lie! I'm sorry!!! MAKE IT STOP!"

He didn’t. Even when the machine broke the bones in Uta’s arm or when it began to twist the muscle, splintered bone and flesh. The
ghoul finally twisted his own torso sharply away from the destroyed arm and it finished ripping off, still held by the wrist in the grip of
the mechanical restraint.

“You see Aika-san...this is what happens. It is a bit more dramatic than a shock I shall admit. But for a Ghoul, this is what is necessary for
you to understand, I believe.”

“I’m sorry, I’m sorry, I’m sorry...I won’t lie again. Uta—I’m sorry—”

It’s all my fault. All my fault. All my fault. We were going to be hurt. Tortured. Questioned. And taken apart like frogs being dissected and

it would be all my fault! I was a burden. A cancer in his life that tracked this monster to him and possibly his friends as well. Maybe if I
never met him he’d be safe now—in his shop alone but safe. Much happier without me—

“I love you, Ai...” My thoughts stopped racing for a second and I stared at the ghoul.

He loved me. Even after all this...?

“...I...love you too, Uta-kun...” I whispered, hiccuping softly.

## ♥


I couldn’t afford to reject water, but each time food was offered I refused it. Uta wasn’t fed either and he began to get hungrier. He had
begun to regenerate his arm and the newly formed elbow was hooked securely to the table again.

Two days had passed in this torturous existence. Being poked and prodded and asked questions about how we lived together—I was
starving. Uta was starving . And I could feel the effects of being off the medicine.

My numbers must be rising invisibly. Before long I’d be a ghoul. Depending on when that happened, it could be good or bad for escaping
. If he realized it, then he’d start ripping up my body. I’d be tested and prodded to find out what was wrong with me that made me
suddenly go Ghoul—my whole family’s history would be ripped up and searched through by strangers and the people at home would be
in even greater danger once the CCG found out they all knew. All along.

Twice he left for a total of three hours. Sleep, I assumed since the breaks were at eight hour intervals. A monster though he was, he was
also human after all. He needed sleep, food and rest as much as the rest of us.

The investigator stood next to me scribbling more notes down. He was always careless about standing close to me. Unlike Uta whom he
always gave a healthy breath of distance too. If I turned ghoul here... and he didn’t realize what happened perhaps I could catch him off
guard. It would take just a single careless moment and I could get my hands on him.





“Hum...after healing that wound on your back and having your arm taken off; you must be getting hungry. How do you feel, Uta?”

“...Yes. A little bit.” I watched Uta answer the man's question. I was still horrified that he was being so complacent just to keep me from
being shocked. He had answered everything that was asked of him. Regardless of what it was. The closest he came to denying were
personal questions about our sexual exploits.

And even those, when threatened with my pain Uta relented. Saving me from being shocked another time.

## -

“When you have intercourse, does it ever cross your mind to eat her instead? How is it that you think of her when you two are intimate?” He
had that damnable notebook open, ready to scribble down anything Uta said.



And Uta had answered honestly. ‘Yes. It has. The first time...I wasn’t sure if the feeling I was having was wanting to fuck her or eat her. She’s
mine...that’s how I think of her in those moments...’

‘Possessive behavior then...?’

## -

I watched the investigator look between the two of us debating something.
“I see...I wonder what would happen if you two were in the same room...” He mumbled to himself, and put down his notepad on a table
next to me. I glared at him as he passed and he paused to look at me.

“Don’t get upset with me. Don’t you want to be in the same room as your lover? Perhaps I’ll free you both from your restraints. For that,
I suppose I should make sure to take off his other arm. It would be harder for him to consume you completely...”

I swallowed thickly and glanced towards Uta. He had been fighting his hunger, trying to stay quiet about it. But I could see how he
sniffed and stared. Mostly he watched the investigator with hungry eyes as he passed by. But when the door from my door to his would
open he would scent the air, breathing in the scent and his mouth would water. I knew it wasn’t inside his control—but it was terrifying.

The investigator held a taser like a cattle prod in his hand when he finally released me from the table. “Go on—go to the other room.
You’ll be staying there from now on.”

When I didn't move immediately he jabbed the end of it into my lower back; electrocuting me and sending me sprawling forward. With
him leering over me with the prod I hastily crawled the rest of the way into the other room to avoid another strike from the weapon. The
door shut and locked behind me and the ghoul investigator left the room to observe.

From above I heard the investigator announce something: “You can release him if you would like. There’s a switch on the bottom of the
table.”

“Don’t....” The ghoul said, breath ragged as he raised his head. I could see his hunger in his eyes. “If you let me loose I’ll hurt
you...Don’t...”

“If you don’t. I will. Your choice.” I glanced up at the investigator again; torn.

I looked at Uta and started to walk around the table. I flinched back as the ghoul lunged.
“I told you no...”  He growled, face contorted briefly in anger before his gaze softened and looked pained. “Please...Ai-chan...don’t.”

The machine that he ripped off his other arm began to turn his remaining arm. The ghoul yelled and struggled and I took a few steps back
in horror. “Stop! I’ll let him out...just stop doing this!”

The investigator stared down at us impassively as he watched. Like before, he had no mercy for the ghoul. He wasn’t going to make a
single move to stop Uta’s pain. When one of the clamps that were connected to Uta’s legs started to do the same—I rushed as fast as my
shaking body would allow me around the back of the raised table he was hooked to. I saw a keypad but no buttons.

“The code is 7793.”

My hands shook so bad it was hard to punch in the code. I got it wrong twice and cursed as I continued to hear the bones in Uta’s body
cracking and breaking. “Hold on...hold on...”

I pressed the release button and prayed that I’d managed to punch it in correctly. I heard the ghoul fall to the ground. His body hit with a
thud that wasn’t all together dry. I could smell him too. The blood on the ground spread out from under the other side of the platform
table and soaked the ground.


“Uta...are—” I heard him move on the other side of the platform and groan in pain. I moved slowly, peeking out from around the cover.
He was face down on the ground. Breathing in ragged uneven breaths. From what I could see both legs were badly twisted though they
were still attached. His other arm was practically gone. Holding on by only a few strings of meat that were even now rapidly ripping and
falling apart as I watched.

He raised his head, eyes on me. “Ai—I told you not to release me.”

“He was ripping your arms and legs off like you're a fly...what did you expect me to do?”

“I’m...going to eat you, Ai-chan...”

‘I’m going to eat you.’ It was the first time he said that and I didn’t really feel like it was  a joke. He wasn’t teasing me this time. It was a
warning. Even without his arms or his legs he still thought he was going to hurt me. Eat me.

“Uta—” I glanced up and glared at the investigator who was watching. Notebook in his hands. I crawled out from around the metal
table platform and to Uta who looked just as horrified as I felt by his water mouth and by the string of drool that escaped as he stared at
my body.

“You're not going to kill me...”

The ghoul didn’t have arms but I could see his back, kagune bursting from his back. He wasn’t fully recovered so the tail that emerged
was flimsy and almost stringy. Barely holding together. Even when it wrapped around my wrist and pulled me closer to him it felt weaker
than usual.

I tried to scramble away but was tugged closer. Uta leaned up on his half formed elbow and one of his broken twisted legs; pushing up on
the shattered knee and used the rest of his body weight to pin me down. I saw his unfocused eyes as they searched for a place to place his
mouth—

In the split second before his teeth met my flesh I saw tears gathering on the edges of his eyes, ready to fall. Then he opened his mouth—
and clamped down on my upper arm. His teeth broke skin and I held back a scream of pain and terror as it surged through me.

“Uta—P-please— I have a plan...” I desperately begged under my breath. Hoping that it might bring him back. But the ghoul’s mouth
pulled back, taking flesh with it and for a moment everything blacked out...

## ♥

...everything came rushing back. My arm felt really warm. Wet. Pulsing.

I could see Uta chewing . Mouth bloodied. A piece of pale meat and skin hanging from his lips. He moaned softly as he ate even as a few
tears fell down his face. Swallowing down the flesh he searched again and picked another spot to bite down on. A meaty part of my bicep.
Each time he took I black out for a few seconds—

“Uta...” I couldn’t get a word in between bites. Nothing I said he seemed to hear and I began to give up. He was going to eat me. Just like
he said he would.
But maybe he’d survive...maybe the clowns would break him out of prison. Itori would try. Nico might help Itori. Renji might help...he’d say

“Well I suppose even if a ghoul loves someone they will still eat their ‘mate’. Especially if they are human. It took much longer than I

Above me I saw the investigator, leaving me to my fate. Leaving his observation room and leaving me with Uta. Even if he was a monster,

apparently he couldn't stomach to watch. Alone now, the ghoul took another bite, another meaty place on my arm. He continued to
moan as he ate—

He shifted, using his kagune and broken limbs to move so he leaned over my thighs. I considered trying to kick him and fight him off but
I was already pretty dizzy and faint. I could barely summon enough strength to lift my head. If I was going to die; or worse...if Uta was
going to be the one to kill me then I had to say something. I had to hope he could hear me. Say something for when I was dead and gone.

“I...I’m sorry...I got us caught. It’s...my fault...I...” I swallowed thickly. “ I forgive you ...I still...loved you. Until the end...” I screamed
again as he took another bite, sinking his teeth into my left thigh and pulling off a large chunk of meat. I felt tears slide down my face and
breathed rapidly, enduring the pain.

Between bites I could feel him sliding his tongue over the blood as it dripped down between my thighs.

The investigator checked in twice more. I counted time between each visit to keep myself sane.
Uta continued to eat. My one leg felt almost numb, while the other still felt like it was on fire.

Then...suddenly he stopped.

The ghoul laid himself down on my bleeding body and restedhis head on my stomach. I didn’t trust my voice to speak and I was too
unsure if he really was stopping to stay anything. But the ghoul stayed still for so long, just breathing.

## Silent.

It was only when his body shook and I felt something warm and wet drip on me that I managed to lift my head to look at him. He was
crying. “Uta...” He lifted his head, staring at me with wide weeping eyes. “Ai...I...didn’t kill you.”

He looked surprised by that fact. But it wasn’t necessarily true. I couldn’t see how much he’d taken off me. It didn’t feel good but...

I wasn’t feeling as dizzy. “...no. You didn’t...it’s okay....I love you.” I need to say that. I need to keep saying it even after something so
terrible and terrifying. The muscles in my one arm and my thighs must be in ribbons, bitten, chewed and eaten by Uta.

But they must not be bleeding anymore.

“Uta...I’ve got an idea...”

A terrible idea.

## Chapter 84: Escape
