## Hair Aesthetic, Symbolism & Character
## Presence
Based on Aika's different illustrations, her hair has a distinctive visual
identity: voluminous, theatrical, expressive and deliberately unconventional.
Its dramatic silhouette and contrasting plum-to-crimson coloring contribute
significantly to her overall presence.
Rather than functioning as a purely decorative feature, her hairstyle visually
complements the different sides of her personality. It can appear
sophisticated and carefully arranged, playfully unruly, or completely
disordered depending on how she wears it and the emotional state being
portrayed.
Its defining characteristics are its exceptional volume, sculpted waves,
prominent curls, outward-flicking ends and sharply contrasting colors.
## 1. Dangerous Elegance & Dramatic Sophistication
Aika's immense hair volume, pronounced S-shaped waves and heavy ringlets
create an unusually striking silhouette. Her hair occupies considerable visual
space, framing her face and shoulders with large, sculpted locks rather than
falling in a conventional, understated hairstyle.
When arranged into a high, voluminous bun or elaborate updo, the effect
becomes particularly sophisticated. The structured styling complements her
tailored business clothing, gold jewelry and refined presentation. When worn
loose or swept over one shoulder, the same hair takes on a more relaxed,
dramatic appearance.
The plum-to-crimson color transition reinforces this visual contrast. The
muted plum roots provide a darker foundation, while the saturated crimson
lengths introduce intensity and warmth. The combination creates a
distinctive, almost theatrical appearance that can feel luxurious, striking and
slightly intimidating.

This is particularly effective in her high-ranking business appearance, where
her elaborate hairstyle complements rather than competes with her tailored
clothing.
Her beauty is noticeable without requiring her to constantly perform for
attention. She can occupy a room simply by being present.
## 2. Unruly Energy & Rebellious Undercurrents
Despite its volume and occasional elaborate styling, Aika's hair never feels
entirely conventional or restrained.
The short, thorn-like tufts around her crown, uneven clusters of hair and
sharply outward-flicking ends prevent the silhouette from becoming too
polished. Her curls are substantial and sculpted, but their irregular
directions give them movement and personality.
This creates an interesting contrast between structure and disorder.
Even when her hair is arranged into an elaborate updo, individual curls
escape the arrangement, framing her face and falling around her neck and
shoulders. When worn loose, its volume and outward movement become even
more pronounced.
The deep crimson lengths also contribute to its rebellious appearance. Rather
than blending seamlessly into the plum roots, the strong color division gives
the hairstyle an intentionally artificial, graphic quality.
This complements Aika's alternative and punk-influenced personal style. Her
appearance can be refined without becoming conventional, feminine without
becoming delicate, and theatrical without losing its rebellious edge.
The result is a hairstyle that feels expressive and distinctive rather than
perfectly controlled.
## 3. Raw Emotional Expression — The Distress State
When Aika experiences severe emotional distress, her hair can become a
visual extension of her deteriorating composure.
The carefully arranged curls and recognizable styling lose their definition.
Her already voluminous silhouette expands into increasingly irregular,
jagged shapes, with individual locks appearing to flare outward in different
directions.

The familiar structure becomes distorted. Instead of the deliberate S-shaped
waves and heavy ringlets associated with her usual appearance, the hair
takes on a more chaotic, almost explosive silhouette.
The contrast between the muted plum and saturated crimson becomes
especially striking in this presentation.
Rather than representing an entirely different hairstyle, this is an
exaggerated distortion of her established hair architecture. The same
recognizable colors, volume and outward movement remain, but their
arrangement becomes disordered.
The effect visually communicates emotional overload, agitation and the loss
of her usual composure.
Her hair does not independently signify instability; its appearance changes
alongside her expression, posture and overall presentation.

## Aura & Presence
Aika possesses a multifaceted presence that combines refined upbringing,
rebellious individuality, athletic confidence and a theatrical sense of self-
expression.
She can move between considerably different social environments without
losing her recognizable personality. Her business appearance, everyday
streetwear, combat presentation and masked identity all emphasize different
aspects of the same person.
## The Foundation — Refined Confidence &
## Unconventional Individuality
Aika's upbringing gives her familiarity with refinement, presentation and
high-   society expectations. She understands how to carry herself in formal
environments and can adopt an appropriately composed, sophisticated
appearance when necessary.
However, her personality is not limited to that background.

Her natural disposition is more spontaneous, blunt and expressive. She has a
mischievous streak, a willingness to challenge people and a tendency to react
honestly rather than carefully managing every impression she makes.
Her experiences in the Fourth Ward have significantly affected her
relationship with danger, suffering and violence. She becomes more
accustomed to circumstances that would ordinarily provoke fear or
hesitation, sometimes displaying an unsettlingly calm or curious reaction to
disturbing situations.
This does not mean she becomes permanently emotionless or incapable of
vulnerability. Her warmth, humor, frustration and affection remain genuine
parts of her personality.
The distinction is that her experiences have changed what she considers
frightening, what she can tolerate and how readily she exposes her emotions.
## The Tension — Controlled Presentation &
## Unpredictable Charm
Aika's appeal comes partly from the contrast between her outward
presentation and her underlying temperament.
She can appear poised, relaxed and completely self-assured while
simultaneously being mischievous, argumentative or unexpectedly impulsive.
Her expressions contribute considerably to this impression.
A small crooked smile, half-lidded gaze or raised eyebrow can make her
appear amused, knowing or faintly challenging. Her genuine smiles, however,
soften her features and reveal a much warmer side.
She is not constantly calculating her expressions or manipulating everyone
around her. Sometimes she is simply amused. Sometimes she is being
deliberately difficult. Sometimes she genuinely doesn't care what someone
thinks.
When operating under her masked identity, Wendigo, this theatrical quality
becomes much more deliberate.
Her masked presentation exaggerates her unconventional side through an
elaborate costume, exaggerated silhouette and deliberately unsettling visual
elements. The result is a more performative, mischievous and intimidating
version of her outward personality.

She enjoys the freedom of that presentation, allowing herself to be more
theatrical and unpredictable than she might be in ordinary social or business
settings.
## The Impression — Magnetic, Assured & Multifaceted
Aika's presence is defined by contrast rather than a single emotional quality.
She can be elegant without being particularly formal, intimidating without
deliberately threatening someone, affectionate without becoming submissive,
and playful without losing her capacity for seriousness.
She does not consistently seek approval or attention, but neither is she
inherently detached from the people around her.
Her confidence comes from familiarity with herself, her capabilities and her
willingness to occupy space without constantly apologizing for it.
Her appearance can be striking, but her personality is what makes that
appearance memorable.

## Kinetic Movement & Posture
Aika's physical movements reflect her athletic conditioning, flexibility and
adaptable personality. Her movement combines fluidity with efficiency,
allowing her to appear relaxed in ordinary circumstances while retaining
considerable physical capability.
The Gait — Light-Footed & Purposeful
Aika moves with a naturally light, controlled gait. Her steps are relatively
quiet, and her movements rarely appear unnecessarily heavy or rigid.
Her athletic conditioning contributes to her balance, coordination and ability
to change direction quickly.
She can move gracefully without deliberately performing elegance. Her
movements are often economical and instinctive, particularly when
navigating familiar environments.

During combat, this light-footed movement becomes more purposeful. She
pays attention to distance, positioning and opportunities to evade or counter
an opponent.
## The Posture — Relaxed & Unrestrained
Aika does not maintain a permanently upright or formal posture.
When comfortable, she frequently adopts relaxed positions, shifting her
weight, crossing her legs, leaning against furniture or sitting in ways that
prioritize comfort over conventional posture.
Her body language is generally loose and unforced rather than stiff or
military-like.
In business environments, however, she can deliberately adopt a more
composed posture. Sitting upright, crossing her legs, lifting her chin or
maintaining steady eye contact allows her to present a more authoritative
image.
Importantly, her relaxed posture should not be mistaken for an absence of
vulnerability. Aika can be comfortable in her own skin while still becoming
defensive, unsettled, embarrassed or emotionally exposed.
Her posture changes with her surroundings, emotional state and intentions.
## The Mechanics — Flexibility, Conditioning & Explosive
## Power
Aika's physicality combines fluid movement with substantial athletic
conditioning.
Her movements favor flexibility, balance, rapid directional changes and
coordinated use of her body rather than relying exclusively on brute force.
Her years of training with Renji contribute to her physical discipline, reaction
speed, endurance and ability to fight against physically stronger opponents.
She has developed a practical understanding of timing, distance, evasion and
striking. Her fighting ability is not simply an extension of her appearance; it
is the result of sustained conditioning and experience.

Her physique remains lean and visibly toned rather than heavily muscular.
Her strength is expressed through functional athleticism, controlled
movement and the ability to generate sudden force when necessary.
There is a distinction between her ordinary movement and her combat
mechanics:
## •
Everyday movement:
Relaxed, fluid, comfortable and occasionally
careless.
## •
Formal presentation:
Deliberate, composed and self-assured.
## •
Combat movement:
Focused, efficient, flexible and physically explosive.
## •
## Distress:
Less controlled, potentially erratic and reflective of her
emotional condition.
Whether she is sitting casually in a tailored business suit, moving through
the city in alternative streetwear or taking a fighting stance, her physicality
retains the same underlying characteristics: flexibility, coordination, athletic
conditioning and an expressive, unconventional presence.


The business illustration shows her seated with her legs crossed, one hand
resting casually on her knee. Her posture is relaxed and self-assured rather
than rigid or militaristic.
Her physical presence should have three distinct qualities:
- At rest: Relaxed, loose-limbed and comfortable. She doesn't need to
stand perfectly straight to appear confident.
- In business settings: Deliberate, poised and controlled. She uses posture
and eye contact to establish authority.
- During combat: Lowered center of gravity, flexible movement, quick
directional changes and explosive strikes.
## 4.

## Athletic Conditioning & Movement
- Aika's physical conditioning is built through years of training.
- Her movement combines flexibility, balance, quick reactions and
explosive power.
- She favors fluid directional changes, efficient footwork and adaptable
positioning rather than relying on brute strength.
- Her casual posture can be loose and relaxed, but her fighting posture is
considerably more controlled.
- Her training with Renji develops her ability to withstand pressure,
recognize openings and continue fighting despite physical discomfort.

## PART X — AIKA’S TATTOO


## .
Aika's Bicep Tattoo (Created & Inked by Uta)
The tattoo is framed inside a rectangular, scroll-like black border, displaying a highly
stylized, cyclical composition.
## •
## The Motif:
Two antlered deer-wolves are locked in a fluid, circular chase—
resembling an ouroboros. The creature on the left curves downward, while the
creature on the right curves upward to complete the loop.
## •
## The Lineart & Styling:
The linework utilizes heavy, bold black ink done in a
traditional, flowy woodblock or wave-like pattern. Swirling clouds or smoke
elements fill the negative space around the two beasts.
## The Color Palette:
The piece is rendered using a striking contrast of deep
black shadows, bloody red accents tracing the curves of the beasts, soft pale
pink shading to create dimension, and stark, bright white highlights to make
the forms pop against the dark backdrop
The meaning derives from Hiroshi’s two-wolves philosophy and represents
balance rather than suppression.


the subway I took out my phone and started to type in my order.
I paused, looking at all the options for pizza. I recalled
there were some pretty funny things you could do with ordering
delivery. Uta could be a pretty playful guy - but being a
Ghoul he wouldn’t have ever had the chance to do certain things.
Maybe one of these days I’d do it and see what he
thought of it.
There were plenty of fun things like “none-pizza with left beef’
that he might find funny.
But for now I simply ordered a pie and relaxed in my seat. Until I
felt weight on my shoulder and warmth at my side as the
ghoul leaned on me with his chin resting on my shoulder.
He was watching as I made the food order. I should push him
away, or even just wiggle away from the exchange but...
Even though there was heat in my cheeks I couldn’t help but
enjoy the nervous energy that filled my stomach with
butterflies. I was guilty of enjoying this attention but I couldn’t
even rally enough nerve to ask him why he did it. It was a
Ghoul thing? But none of the others were so touchy. If anything
it seemed like they were even less likely to try to get close.
Not even Shuu had acted like this when we were younger.
But I hadn’t seen him for nearly the whole week...I missed it.

Even after I was done ordering the ghoul didn’t remove himself
from my side. Instead I felt a pair of fingers fiddling with
my ears and realized that the ghoul was wiggling my newer
piercings and examining them. They no longer hurt when they
are moved. Since I’d gotten them I’d kept them exceptionally
clean and wiggled them almost religiously. “How do they
look, Uta?”“They’re healing nicely. If you wanted more, I think it
would be fine to add them in a few more days.”
“Yeah I still do want the second ones in the upper lobe.” I felt him
gently pinch where I mentioned.
“Here?”
“Yup. That's the spot. And maybe in a few months...a tattoo? If
you're still up for doing it?”
Based solely on the way his eyes widened up and almost glittered
I assumed the answer was a definite yes. “Have you
thought of something you wanted?”
“I was trying too...” I turned my head and wiggled my shoulder
finally. Forcing the ghoul to move his head and stare at me.
It felt a bit like kicking a cat off your lap after they got
comfortable. I looked at his neck tattoo's. “Maybe my favorite
quote...not around my neck though...”
“What’s your favorite quote?”
“I guess it’s not a quote per say...There's just a story I was told as
a kid. And it always just stuck with me." Uta leaned his
head back on my shoulder as he listened. It really was pointless
shaking off a cat (or an Uta) from your lap or shoulder in
this case. They’d just come back anyway. “It’s kind of a long story
though...”
“Let’s hear it...”
I took a moment to remember the whole thing, the way it was
told to me. With a deep breath, I started to retell it. “The
story went: An old Cherokee told his child the story of two
wolves. Because there are two wolves fighting in everybody's
mind. One that is good. He is Joy, peace, love, hope, serenity,
humility, kindness, benevolence, empathy, generosity, truth

and compassion. The second wolf; He is evil. He is anger, hatred,
envy, sorrow, regret, greed, arrogance, self-pity, guilt,
resentment, lies, false pride, and ego.”
“The child asks: Which one will win? And the old man tells him.
“The one you feed...”
I smiled to myself as I remembered my uncle telling that to me
years ago on a trip into the woods. I had sat at the edge of
the fire staring up at the aging man while he told me stories.
“But that wasn’t really the end to the story exactly. Because
while they do fight, neither of the wolves will ever die.”“If you
only feed the good wolf, the evil one will be waiting around every
corner to strike when you become weak or
distracted. Ignore him and he will be angry and lash out. But if
you acknowledge both wolves, they will both be happy and
at peace. Because while many see him as ‘evil’ he has qualities
that are good. Tenacity, courage, fearlessness, a strong will
and strategic thinking. We need those things sometimes. While
the ‘good’ wolf is kind and gentle, it doesn't have the
strength and ability to recognize what’s in the best interest of all.
To try to starve one side is to ignore half of your feelings.
You’ll only have peace if you feed both and maintain a balance.
My uncle taught me that...”
I took a deep breath and sighed out. “That’s way too long for a
tattoo quote though. I need something shorter or maybe
you can come up with a small image for the story?”
Uta was gazing at me; unblinking as I finished the retelling. His
eyes looked far off and lost in thought. He nodded silently
to my question, but didn’t reply past that.
I had had a similar reaction to it when I’d heard the story for the
first time. I had been an unruly child - even in captivity I
was a monster to the hired help. Lashing out for my situation
they had little to no control over - but that had helped me
back then.
I relaxed and let the ghoul think in silence as we finished our
ride home. I nudged him off my shoulder again when I had to
stand up for our stop. “Uta, we’re here.”

“Hum?” He looked around noticing we were back. “Oh, I see.”
“Let's hurry, the pizza should be delivered soon and I don’t
wanna miss it!”
## ♥
The boy who delivered the food was a small teenager with a
mousey, timid look and quiet voice. He had knocked but then
barely whispered: “Pizza for a Ms. Aika.” I took my pizza and
handed him his tip. I bid him a safe trip back and he sped off
again. I couldn’t blame him for not wanting to stick around the
area for long.
While I ate I noticed Uta watching me. Midway through a
mouthful I stopped and raised an eyebrow at him: sending him a
silent ‘what?’ He looked away and towards his sketchbook.“That
story you told me. You want something drawn inspired by it? And
if I draw something...you’ll let me tattoo it onto
you?” I had been looking over his art since the time I’d met him
and loved every piece. Even the ones where he caught me
sleeping with my mouth dropped open. Unflattering as those had
been; they were good. So I didn’t hesitate to nod with the
food still in my mouth. “Whatever I draw, Ai-chan? It’s more
permanent than an earring.”
I swallowed my food and nodded again. “As long as it’s something
inspired by the story, and nothing too big...” I looked at
his hands. All the intricate little details were amazing when you
realized the tattoo’s themselves were only a few inches
across. Even if he did miss the mark on the story I did believe
anything he drew would be amazing. “I like the ones you
have. Especially the ones on the back of your hands and across
your knuckles. They’re small but so detailed...”
He didn’t seem put off by my requirements, in fact after I agreed
he stood up and came over to me; leaning down and took
a look over my body. Self consciously I squirmed in my seat as he
hovered around me.
“I’m only looking for a good place for one.” Stopping at my upper
right arm and prodding me he asked. “How about

here?” I was relieved that he picked a normal place and not
somewhere I’d have to tell him ‘no’. As much as I loved his
tattoos I wasn't ready to start completely filling up my skin with
permanent marks.
He grabbed the measuring tools he normally used on people’s
heads and faces as well as his sketchbook and measured out
how much ‘canvas’ he'd have to draw on. Once he was done
getting measurements he retreated back to his desk and bent
over his sketchbook; already working on it.
I continued to chow down on dinner before I finally hit the full
mark. I closed the box and made a mental note to put this
away at home to save for tomorrow’s lunch. Uta lifted his head as
I moved closer. His sketchbook was closed before I could
get even a peek at what he’d started on. I raised my hands and
smiled innocently. “Alright, alright. I won’t ruin the surprise.
But I’m heading home for now."
“Already?” The disappointment in his voice almost made me tell
him I’d stay. After being away for so long I didn’t
necessarily want to leave so soon. But I had to get back to Bjorn
at home. Give him a walk. Plus, I wanted to take a trip to
some stores before it got dark.
“Yeah...But I’ll be back tomorrow if you’ll be around. I’m free all
weekend actually. I had an idea for something fun we can
do. It’ll be my surprise if I can find what I’m looking for tonight.
I’m about to head out to some stores with Bjorn!”
I waved as I exited the building leaving the male to think up the
tattoo he wanted to place on me. I still felt bad for leaving
so soon but if I could find what I was looking for then it would be
worth it!♥

## Aika’s Wendigo Mask

## 
## The True Meaning Behind Aika’s Mask
Based on her deep conversation with Uta, the mask is a haunting artistic mirror of
Aika's dual nature. Rather than a random creation, Uta tailored it dynamically to
express the psychological tension he sensed within her.
## 
Why Aika Had the Mask Made
## •
Through the Eye of the Artist:
Aika did not get the mask made for a specific
mission, event, or to hide a secret identity. Her motivation was entirely driven
by a deep admiration for Uta’s craftsmanship.
## •
## A Pure Curiosity:
She genuinely wanted to see how Uta perceived her through his
creative vision. She sought a tangible, artistic representation of how she looked
"through the eye of the artist."
## 
How Uta Saw Her (The Design's Symbolism)
Uta explicitly notes that Aika defied his expectations—she was a "cute girl asking for
such a creepy mask." Her final piece perfectly balances this exact contradiction,
treading a fine line between pretty and eerie:
## •
The Soft Outer Layer (How She Appears):
The soft white fox fur, flexible leather
doe-like ears, and delicate pinkish-red blooms wrapping the antlers represent
her approachable, "cute," and gentle exterior.
## •
The Skeletal Core (What Lies Beneath):
The raw wolf-jaw bone base and jagged,
blood-tipped stag antlers represent her hidden, darker fascinations—such as
hunting and fishing with her uncle , collecting animal skulls, and chanting to the
"Blood God."
## •
The Central Conflict (The Caught Spider):
The fine wire spiderweb stretched
between her antlers serves as the ultimate metaphor for her existence. As Aika
herself realizes, the design poses an open question:
Is she the predator that has
caught the spider in her antlers, or is she the gentle creature hopelessly
trapped in a dangerous web?
Uta heavily implies she is a mixture of both.
## The Complete Mask Appearance
Based on the illustration and the text description, this haunting headpiece merges raw
animal bone, soft fur, and delicate dark foliage to create a striking balance between
beautiful and eerie.

Ahhh, yes! You’re talking about the shooting stars from the scene where Aika and Uta
lie together in the clearing, not just stars in general. And you’re right: Uta made her
mask, so the details could be his way of incorporating that shared memory into
something he created for her.
## ❤
In Chapter 53, the scene describes:
- They’re lying side by side on a blanket in a clearing near Hiroshi’s cabin.
- Aika is holding Uta’s hand.
- The sky is exceptionally clear, with thousands of visible stars.
- The sky is deep blue and purple, fading into black toward the east.
- Aika tells Uta that she sometimes sleeps outside, especially during meteor
showers.
- She tells him to make a wish if he sees a shooting star.
- Uta starts to say his wish aloud, but Aika stops him, explaining that wishes
shouldn’t be spoken.
The important detail is that Uta makes a wish, too. We aren’t told exactly what he
wishes for.
Connecting that to her mask
The black stars hanging from the strings on Aika’s mask could represent those
shooting stars.
I particularly like that interpretation because:
- Uta was present for the memory.
- He heard Aika explain the tradition.
- He made a wish alongside her.
- He later created her mask, giving him an opportunity to incorporate a private
memory into its design.

There’s also a lovely little distinction: Aika told him not to say his wish aloud. So
whatever he wished for remains his own secret.
My interpretation: Those dangling stars aren’t merely decorative. They can be a quiet
reference to a night they shared, and to a wish Uta never told her about.
And because Uta made the mask himself, that makes the symbolism especially
meaningful.

Yes    —   and after checking the DGG appearance reference, I’d make some
important corrections to your original classification.
## ❤


The biggest one is that Aika’s beauty is not built around a conventionally
sharp face or a naturally cat-shaped eye. Her actual facial structure is softer
and more expressive than that description suggests.

Her defining combination is:

- Rounded-almond eyes that are naturally downturned.
- Soft, rounded-heart facial proportions.
- A small, delicate nose.
- A pronounced Cupid’s bow and particularly full lower lip.
- Strong, graphic eyebrows that contrast with her softer facial structure.
- Dramatic, voluminous plum-to-crimson hair.
- A lean, athletic hourglass physique with substantial natural curves.

There is also an important distinction between her facial beauty, her
hairstyles, her body silhouette and the aesthetic she adopts through clothing.
Those shouldn’t all be treated as the same classification.

I’d rebuild the reference around those four elements.

Aika’s revised beauty reference


## Aika Kaneshiro —   Facial Beauty, Hair, Body Type & Different Beauty
## Presentations

- Her underlying beauty: Soft doll-like features meets expressive feline
beauty

Aika’s defining beauty comes from the contrast between her soft facial
proportions and her unusually expressive features.

She does not have an inherently angular, sharply sculpted or conventionally
feline face. Her underlying structure is softer, with rounded contours, a
gently tapered lower face and prominent expressive features.

Her beauty combines:

- Doll-like facial softness.
- Rounded-almond, naturally downturned eyes.
- Expressive, feline-looking half-lidded eyes.
- Strong, graphic eyebrows.
- A small, delicate nose.
- A pronounced Cupid’s bow and full lower lip.
- A rounded-heart facial impression.

Facial structure

Overall face shape:
Aika has a soft, rounded-heart facial structure. Her upper and central facial
proportions retain noticeable softness, while her lower face gradually narrows
toward a delicate, tapered chin.

Her jawline is defined without being square, angular or particularly sharp.
Her cheeks retain gentle fullness, preventing her face from becoming
excessively narrow or gaunt.

Her mature appearance develops a more refined lower-face contour, but the
underlying softness remains recognizable.

## Cheeks:
Her cheeks have natural rounded fullness, contributing to her youthful, doll-
like appearance. They are not extremely prominent or sharply hollowed.

Chin and jaw:

Her chin is delicate and gently tapered. Her jawline follows a soft contour
rather than a pronounced angular structure.

## Nose:
Aika has a small, compact and delicate nose. Its bridge is relatively short and
softly defined, with a small rounded tip and understated nostrils. It
complements her facial proportions rather than dominating the centre of her
face.

Lips and mouth:
One of her most distinctive facial features is her mouth.

- A sharply defined, geometric Cupid’s bow.
- A comparatively thinner upper lip.
- A noticeably fuller, rounded lower lip.
- Naturally expressive mouth corners.
- A wide, mischievous smile that can become almost exaggerated.

Her smile is particularly recognizable. When she grins, her mouth stretches
into a confident, sweeping expression that makes her look amused,
mischievous or as though she knows something everyone else doesn’t.

She also has naturally pronounced, pointed canine teeth, which were present
during her human years and are not a Ghoul-specific mutation.

Eyes: Her most important defining feature

Aika’s eyes are not exclusively doe-eyed or cat-eyed.

She has one consistent underlying anatomical structure: large, naturally
downturned rounded-almond eyes.

Their defining characteristics include:

- Broad central fullness.
- Rounded inner and central contours.
- Naturally downward-inclining outer corners.
- Pronounced upper eyelid curvature.
- Full lower eyelids.
- Tapered outer thirds.
- Large, expressive irises.
- Noticeable upper eyelashes.


Her eyes change their visual impression considerably depending on how
widely she opens them.

When fully open:
Her eyes reveal their rounded, downturned structure. They can appear doe-
eyed, doll-like, startled, vulnerable, playful or almost unnervingly wide.

When relaxed or half-lidded:
Her heavy upper eyelids conceal some of the rounded contour, making her
eyes appear longer, narrower and more feline.

This is where her languid, sophisticated and slightly intimidating appearance
comes from.

Her eyebrows:
Her eyebrows are naturally bold, dark and graphic. They have thick, block-
like inner sections, distinctive vertical hash-mark details at their inner
fronts, and strong arches that taper into sharp outer points.

Their strong shape contrasts with her softer facial proportions.

Her defining facial combination

Soft rounded-heart structure + naturally downturned rounded-almond eyes +
strong graphic eyebrows + delicate nose + pronounced Cupid’s bow + full
lower lip.

This is the foundation of her beauty at every age.

## ⸻

- Her hair: Dramatic, theatrical and unmistakably unconventional

Aika’s hair is one of the most recognizable elements of her overall
appearance.

It is not simply long, curly hair. Its volume, sculpted texture, irregular
silhouette and distinct colour separation give it an unusually dramatic
presence.

## Colour


Her hair has a distinctive two-tone colour arrangement.

Roots and crown:
A muted, dusty plum with greyed, berry-purple undertones. The colour is
approximately represented by #8D576A.

## Lengths:
The plum gradually transitions around the mid-neck area into a much more
saturated crimson-red. The red continues through the majority of the
remaining length and reaches the curled ends.

The tips of her sweeping bangs also carry the red colour.

The contrast between the muted plum crown and saturated crimson lengths
is intentional and visually important. Her hair should not be described as one
uniform burgundy or purple shade.

Texture and silhouette

- Exceptionally voluminous.
- Large, sculpted curls and substantial ringlets.
- Pronounced S-shaped waves.
- Thick, sweeping sections that frame her face.
- Irregular, outward-flicking ends.
- Shorter, thorn-like tufts around the crown.
- Noticeable movement and unevenness throughout the silhouette.

Her curls have considerable body rather than hanging as thin, delicate
ringlets.

Even when carefully styled, her hair retains an irregular, expressive quality.

Hairstyle variations

Worn loose: Her heavy curls cascade around her shoulders and frame her
face. This creates a dramatic, feminine and slightly unruly appearance.

Swept over one shoulder: The asymmetry emphasizes the volume and
contrasting colours while creating a more relaxed silhouette.


Business updo: Her hair is arranged into a large, rounded, voluminous updo.
Sculpted curls surround her head, with loose tendrils framing her face and
neck.

Casual styling: The curls are less controlled, with more visible irregularity,
outward-flicking ends and an intentionally messy appearance.

Her hair is simultaneously feminine, rebellious, theatrical and
unconventional. It can look luxurious without becoming conventionally
polished.

## ⸻

- Her body type: Athletic, feminine hourglass beauty

Aika has a lean, athletic hourglass physique with substantial natural curves.

She is petite in height, particularly compared with Uta, but she is not
narrow-framed, straight-bodied or excessively slender.

Her proportions combine an athletic upper body, a sharply defined waist and
a naturally fuller lower body.

Overall silhouette

- Lean, athletic build.
- Defined hourglass proportions.
- Narrow, sharply defined waist.
- Naturally broad, rounded hips.
- Full, developed thighs.
- Rounded, proportionate backside.
- Moderately full, naturally rounded bust.
- Toned shoulders and arms.
- Flat, firm abdomen and conditioned core.

Her physique is feminine and visibly curvaceous without appearing bulky or
exaggerated.

Upper body

Her shoulders have moderate athletic width, with subtle definition around
the deltoids.


Her arms are slender but firm and conditioned, with developed upper-arm
muscles that reflect her physical training.

Her neck is long and graceful, with subtly defined collarbones.

Her bust is moderately full and proportionate to her ribcage and overall
frame.

Waist and core

Her waist is distinctly narrow, creating a pronounced inward curve beneath
her ribcage.

Her abdomen is flat and firm, with a conditioned core rather than an
excessively thin appearance.

Hips and lower body

Her hips are naturally broad and rounded.

Her thighs are full, athletic and proportionate to her hips. Her glutes have
natural projection and developed muscle, creating a rounded, lifted
appearance.

Her lower body is an important part of her silhouette. She should not be
portrayed as a narrow-hipped, straight-bodied or extremely thin woman.

Overall body classification

Lean athletic hourglass with a dancer-like physique.

Her proportions combine feminine curves with physical conditioning,
strength, flexibility and athletic capability.

Her beauty is not exclusively delicate or ornamental. Her physical presence
can also be strong, agile and formidable.

## ⸻

- Business Aika: Aristocratic, commanding and sophisticated beauty


Primary classifications:

- Aristocratic beauty.
- Sophisticated feminine beauty.
- Commanding beauty.
- Refined elegance.
- High-fashion beauty.

This is her most deliberately constructed appearance.

Her business persona draws from her mother’s mannerisms, particularly her
posture, elevated chin and habit of looking at people from beneath her
eyelashes.

Her underlying features do not change. Instead, her presentation makes
particular features more prominent.

Facial presentation:

- Relaxed, half-lidded eyes.
- Strong eyebrows.
- Precisely defined eyeliner.
- Full lower lip emphasized with rosy-coral lipstick.
- Slightly elevated chin.
- Controlled, self-assured expressions.

## Hair:
Her enormous plum-and  -crimson curls are arranged into an elaborate,
rounded updo, with carefully sculpted curls and loose face-framing tendrils.

## Clothing:
Tailored charcoal blazer, deep-red neckline and gold jewelry.

Two expressions:

The composed expression gives her sophisticated, confident and expensive-
looking beauty.

The colder expression, with a raised chin and downward gaze, creates a much
more intimidating aristocratic appearance.

She can look elegant without looking hostile.


## ⸻

- Casual Aika: Alternative, punk-inspired and mischievous beauty

Primary classifications:

- Alternative beauty.
- Punk-inspired beauty.
- Unconventional feminine beauty.
- Rebellious beauty.
- Mischievous beauty.

Her casual appearance emphasizes personality rather than refinement.

The contrast between her naturally soft face and deliberately unconventional
styling is particularly effective.

Her age-26 reference is a good example:

- Oversized charcoal-black crop top.
- Exposed midriff.
- Low-rise black shorts.
- Utility straps and hanging metallic chain.
- Relaxed, asymmetrical posture.
- Messier, less controlled hair.

Her expressions contribute significantly to this presentation.

A crooked grin makes her look mischievous. A half-lidded expression makes
her appear languid and unimpressed. A genuine smile brings out her softer
facial proportions.

Her appearance feels lived-in, expressive and rebellious rather than carefully
arranged.

## ⸻

- Romantic Aika: Soft, feminine and approachable beauty

Primary classifications:


- Romantic beauty.
- Soft feminine beauty.
- Doll-like beauty.
- Approachable beauty.
- Expressive beauty.

This presentation emphasizes the softness that remains beneath her more
intimidating expressions.

Her rounded cheeks, delicate nose, full lower lip and rounded-heart facial
structure become particularly noticeable.

Her voluminous curls frame her cheeks and neck, making her appearance
softer without removing its dramatic quality.

Her genuine smiles are particularly important.

When she smiles naturally, the tension around her eyes disappears. Her
expression becomes warmer, her mouth opens into a much more animated
smile, and the calculating quality of her usual expression recedes.

She can appear warm and approachable without looking innocent or fragile.

## ⸻

- Formal feminine Aika: Ornamental and playful beauty

Primary classifications:

- Ornamental feminine beauty.
- Decorative elegance.
- Youthful femininity.
- Playful sophistication.

Her age-23 red-and  -white outfit demonstrates this presentation.

The high neckline, tiered white shoulder ruffles, segmented gold necklace,
matching bracelet and pleated pink skirt create a decorative, carefully
dressed appearance.

Her facial softness and voluminous hair complement the ornamental
clothing.


However, her expressions introduce a contradiction.

Her clothing suggests a respectable, well-presented young woman, while her
grin suggests she might be planning something terrible.

This differs from her business appearance.

Business Aika relies on restraint and authority. Formal Aika relies on
decorative styling, feminine presentation and expressive contrast.

## ⸻

- Fourth Ward Aika: Uncanny doll, impish and mischievous beauty

Primary classifications:

- Uncanny doll beauty.
- Impish beauty.
- Expressive doll-like beauty.
- Playfully sinister beauty.

This is one of her most distinctive presentations.

Her age-23 facial expressions are particularly exaggerated.

Her eyes become extremely wide, revealing their rounded structure and large
irises. Her eyebrows and animated mouth amplify the intensity.

Her grin can become unusually wide, with disconnected outer smile details
and exposed pointed canines.

The contrast between her soft facial proportions and unnervingly cheerful
expressions creates an almost uncanny appearance.

She can look adorable one moment and deeply unsettling the next.

This is not conventional cute beauty. It is doll-like expressiveness with an
impish, mischievous quality.

## ⸻


- Wendigo Aika: Gothic, theatrical and macabre beauty

Primary classifications:

- Gothic theatrical beauty.
- Fantastical beauty.
- Macabre ornamental beauty.
- Monstrous beauty.

Wendigo is different because the appearance is deliberately constructed
around an alternative identity.

The white horned mask, red-and  -black eye detailing, theatrical costume and
flowing red fabric create an exaggerated, recognizable silhouette.

Her beauty here is not primarily about her visible facial attractiveness.

It is about spectacle, shape, contrast, visual deception and the theatrical
presentation of a masked Ghoul.

The mask conceals her identity while retaining visual elements associated
with Aika’s recognizable design.

## ⸻

- Combat Aika: Athletic, fierce and formidable beauty

Primary classifications:

- Athletic beauty.
- Fierce feminine beauty.
- Dynamic beauty.
- Formidable beauty.

This presentation emphasizes her physical conditioning and movement.

Her athletic hourglass physique is not simply decorative. It belongs to
someone who trains, fights, moves quickly and understands how to use her
body.

Her posture becomes more controlled, her gaze more focused and her
expressions less playful.


Her physical presence communicates capability rather than fragility.

Her beauty remains feminine, but it is accompanied by strength, confidence
and a willingness to be dangerous.

## ⸻

- How her appearance changes from 23 to 26 to 27–28

Her age progression should not be treated as three completely different facial
structures.

## ⸻

Overall assessment

Aika’s strongest underlying beauty combination is:

Soft rounded-heart facial structure + expressive doll-like eyes + feline-looking
half  -lidded expressions + pronounced lips + dramatic plum-and  -crimson curls
+ athletic feminine hourglass proportions.

Her beauty is not exclusively cute, elegant, alternative or intimidating.

Her facial features provide a recognizable foundation. Her hair creates a
dramatic silhouette. Her physique gives her a distinctly feminine but athletic
presence. Her expressions and styling determine which qualities become most
prominent.

The most important distinction is that Aika’s beauty does not depend on
being permanently polished, delicate or conventionally feminine.


She can look aristocratic in a tailored suit, ridiculous and impish while
grinning, exhausted in casual clothes, romantic while relaxed, or genuinely
frightening when she bares her teeth.

All of those appearances belong to the same woman.

My biggest correction: I’d make Expressive Doll-like Beauty her permanent
facial classification, rather than treating it as just another outfit-dependent
aesthetic. Her feline appearance is largely created by her eyelids and
expressions, not by a naturally upturned cat-eye anatomy. And her athletic
hourglass physique deserves its own place in the reference rather than being
hidden underneath descriptions of feminine beauty.
